st_05-01.description: Victories are short, but wars are long, and our enemies are unknown.

main_06-01.name: Deadlock
main_06-01.description: Heavily-armored Infected hosts have appeared in Lungmen's urban districts. Not only are they able to shrug off most blows, but they are also capable of regenerating. Exercise caution when dealing with them.

main_06-02.name: Misunderstandings
main_06-02.description: What kind of abominations are those?! New, grotesque Infected combatants have been seen throughout the combat zones of Lungmen. Their speed and power greatly exceed that of regular hosts, so please be careful!

main_06-02#f#.name: Misunderstandings
main_06-02#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The Attack Speed of enemy units is increased significantly.

main_06-03.name: Lost at Once
main_06-03.description: The ranks of these aggressive hosts continue to grow, and they will soon apply heavy pressure to our formation. However, their lives seem to also be quickly burning out...

main_06-03#f#.name: Lost at Once
main_06-03#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Enraged Possessed Soldiers have greatly increased ATK.

main_06-04.name: Festering Scars
main_06-04.description: This area is under attack by aggressive hosts that hurl projectiles at us. Please beware of their long-range attacks.

main_06-04#f#.name: Festering Scars
main_06-04#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Enraged Possessed Throwers have greatly increased HP.

main_06-05.name: Who to Kill?
main_06-05.description: A large number of both melee and ranged Possessed Soldiers have appeared. Perhaps a well-planned defense can halt their onslaught...

main_06-05#f#.name: Who to Kill?
main_06-05#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Enraged Possessed Units no longer lose HP over time.

st_06-01.name: Leave it Behind
st_06-01.description: He has never forgotten the promise he once made...

main_06-06.name: Broken Strings
main_06-06.description:
As the commander of Rhodes Island, you must direct your Operators in a battle against Faust, one of the leaders of Reunion. Be careful.
<@lv.item><Turrets></> periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

main_06-07.name: It Fell From the Sky!
main_06-07.description: The legendary Yeti Squadron, an elite anti-Ursus squad of Infected, has appeared in a Chernobog sub-city. Their fighting style is unlike any Reunion forces we've encountered before, so make sure not to underestimate them.

main_06-07#f#.name: It Fell From the Sky!
main_06-07#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The Speed of enemy units is increased significantly.

tr_16.name: Harsh Environment
tr_16.description: Learn about the 'Cold' and 'Frozen' status effects.

main_06-08.name: Different Perspective
main_06-08.description: The Yeti Squadron, in addition to fielding casters that specialize in ice-based Arts, has also released Originium Slugs that explode in a shower of rime upon death. Please exercise caution.

main_06-08#f#.name: Different Perspective
main_06-08#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Yeti Squadron units and Frostfangs deal even more damage against Frozen units.

main_06-09.name: Bells of Liberation
main_06-09.description: The icecleavers, a special group of combatants of the Yeti Squadron, deal massive damage to frozen Operators. Stay calm when fighting them.

main_06-09#f#.name: Bells of Liberation
main_06-09#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Yeti Icecleavers have greatly increased HP and ASPD.

main_06-10.name: 'Times Like These'
main_06-10.description: A large number of Yeti Squadron troops have launched an offensive against us, and an arduous battle looms ahead. Make good use of our Operators' various strengths and aim to defeat the enemy.

main_06-10#f#.name: 'Times Like These'
main_06-10#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
7 tiles on the map will no longer allow units to be deployed upon them.

main_06-11.name: Snow Upon the Tundra
main_06-11.description:
The Yeti Squadron has placed special Originium facilities around the battlefield. Please be prepared to respond accordingly. 
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></>Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold to affected allied units.

main_06-11#f#.name: Snow Upon the Tundra
main_06-11#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Originium Ice Crystals release frigid waves more frequently.

st_06-02.name: No Light Without Fire
st_06-02.description: She has never forgotten about that certain place...

main_06-12.name: Frost Upon the Tundra
main_06-12.description:
The 'Oneiros' drones controlled by the Yeti Squadron are capable of inflicting Arts damage in an area upon our Operators, as well as inflicting the Cold status. Please prioritize taking them down.
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></>Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold to affected allied units.

main_06-12#f#.name: Frost Upon the Tundra
main_06-12#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Oneiros drones have greatly increased movement speed.

main_06-13.name: Nostalgia
main_06-13.description: Enemy icecleavers have been spotted in conjunction with Oneiros drones. As this will surely be a very difficult battle, please plan carefully to deal with various status abnormalities and enemy attacks.

main_06-13#f#.name: Nostalgia
main_06-13#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemy Oneiros drones have reduced range, but greatly increased HP and DEF.

main_06-14.name: Black Rabbit, White Rabbit
main_06-14.description:
Before us stands the commander of the Yeti Squadron, FrostNova, enhanced with a terrifying power we've never seen before. As she is one of the strongest warriors in Reunion, we must utilize every bit of our strength to overcome her.
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></> Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold to affected allied units.

main_06-15.name: Winter's End
main_06-15.description: We chose to fight to the bitter end. She did as well.

st_06-03.name: Only You Know
st_06-03.description: She has never forgotten about that night...

st_07-01.description: A person walks into the sunset, alone.

main_07-01.name: Night of Farewells
main_07-01.description: Remnants of Reunion's forces remain entrenched in the streets of Lungmen, desperately resisting to the bitter end. Prepare for combat.

main_07-01#f#.name: Night of Farewells
main_07-01#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Possessed Veteran Junkmen and Possessed Soldier Leaders have greatly increased HP.

main_07-02.name: Renegade Blade
main_07-02.description: Mephisto's Herd is no longer under the control of its leader, but their bottomless aggression has prompted them to attack Rhodes Island's ship. Put them out of their misery.

main_07-02#f#.name: Renegade Blade
main_07-02#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The DEF of allied units is halved.

main_07-03.name: Side by Side-1
main_07-03.description: The spearhead of Reunion's reconnaissance force has appeared at the location where we established a concealed facility. Be careful, these are no ordinary Reunion grunts that we're dealing with.

main_07-03#f#.name: Side by Side-1
main_07-03#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
All enemies have increased Movement Speed.

main_07-04.name: Side by Side-2
main_07-04.description: Various Reunion members patrol the passages of the hub layer in the heart of Chernobog. Don't take them lightly; their uniforms... are the same as the Infected guerillas that once fought in the northern tundra of Ursus.

main_07-04#f#.name: Side by Side-2
main_07-04#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The DP Cost of Ranged units is doubled.

tr_17.name: Focused Strike
tr_17.description: Learn how to counter the commanding tactics of Reunion's guerrilla forces.

main_07-05.name: Forgotten Lands
main_07-05.description: We've encountered guerilla messengers on our way to the central area of the core city. They employ a unique method of communication and commanding, and we may perhaps be able to draw some inspiration from fighting against them...

st_07-02.description: A knot that, to this day, has still not been untied.

main_07-06.name: Fury of the Silent-1
main_07-06.description:
We've found a strange Sarkaz Originium altar in the hub layer... The altar seems to have a strange effect upon the surrounding environment, but we can also leverage it to mount a defense against the enemy.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

main_07-07.name: Fury of the Silent-2
main_07-07.description:
Our enemies are no longer fighting in the characteristic style of scattered guerillas. Now is a head-on clash between tactics. Formulate your combat strategy appropriately, and deal a critical blow to the enemy.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

main_07-07#f#.name: Fury of the Silent-2
main_07-07#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Guerrilla Heralds have greatly increased HP.

main_07-08.name: Flames of the Faint
main_07-08.description:
Sarkaz warriors have entered the battlefield, but be wary - they don't seem to be from the same faction as the guerillas. They even seem to draw inspiration from the Originium altars...?!
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

main_07-08#f#.name: Flames of the Faint
main_07-08#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Mercenary Sarkaz Fighters have greatly increased ASPD.

main_07-09.name: Stained-1
main_07-09.description:
Sarkaz Casters have appeared on the battlefield, and it seems like the Originium Altars may be affecting their Arts. However, don't panic - we have ways of dealing with them.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

main_07-09#f#.name: Stained-1
main_07-09#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enemies have -60% Movement Speed, and greatly increased HP and ATK.

main_07-10.name: Stained-2
main_07-10.description:
As Reunion's elite warriors, the Sarkaz Mercenaries have shown formidable strength. Only by defeating them can we continue forward.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></> Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Deploy to block the enemy's route

main_07-11.name: Aegis of the Infected-1
main_07-11.description: The horn has been sounded. Face the legendary guerillas of Ursus, and turn their own tactics against them! However, those heavily-armored guerilla warriors are indeed the most terrifying combatants of the Ursus army...

main_07-11#f#.name: Aegis of the Infected-1
main_07-11#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Sniper and Guard Operators cannot be deployed.

main_07-12.name: Guerilla-1
main_07-12.description: The mortars used by the guerillas pose a significant threat to us. These weapons taken from Ursus's military arsenal are terrifying incarnations of the very essence of war.

main_07-12#f#.name: Guerilla-1
main_07-12#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
All enemies have significantly increased ATK.

main_07-13.name: Guerilla-2
main_07-13.description: The guerillas' Vertical Strike Squad has withstood harsh trials and brutal wars. They've fought Ursus for more than a decade, and their will is nigh indomitable. We have but a single moment for a chance at victory.

main_07-13#f#.name: Guerilla-2
main_07-13#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Guerilla Shieldguards have 66% lower Max HP, but have 50% increased DEF and RES.

main_07-14.name: Unrivaled
main_07-14.description: Who has witnessed a battle like this before? Who can survive such a battlefield? Even a simple skirmish has struck fear into our hearts. We do not have the ability to defeat them. We must escape to where they cannot see us.

main_07-14#f#.name: Unrivaled
main_07-14#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Maximum squad size is reduced to 7 Operators.

main_07-15.name: Aegis of the Infected-2
main_07-15.description:
We cannot destroy them, so we will do our best not to be destroyed by them. We must achieve a tactical victory. We strive to paralyze their spinal cord and expose the giant's head to us.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></> Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

main_07-15#f#.name: Aegis of the Infected-2
main_07-15#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Guard and Caster Operators cannot be deployed.

main_07-16.name: Death of a Patriot
main_07-16.description:
They are commanded by the 'Aegis' of the Infected. The most ancient bloodline among the warriors of Sarkaz. Ursus's indomitable incarnation of war. The backbone of the Reunion Movement. Yelena's father.
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></> Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.
<@lv.item><Interference Mine></>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

main_07-16#f#.name: Death of a Patriot
main_07-16#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
6 tiles on the battlefield are no longer available for deployment.

st_07-03.description: It's like a city driving towards finality.

st_07-04.description: Throw open the doors that lead to this world.

main_08-01.name: Yesterday, the Chaff Cracked
main_08-01.description:
In the remote tundra, patrol squads, dressed in black beetle-like uniforms, comb through remote villages to hunt down the Infected. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></>Blocks the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.

main_08-01#f#.name: Yesterday, the Chaff Cracked
main_08-01#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
3 tiles on the battlefield are no longer available for deployment.

st_08-01.name: Today, Sanguine Overlows
st_08-01.description: 10:32:09 The war continues, but the situation has changed.

tr_18.name: Civilian Evacuation
tr_18.description:
Learn how to evacuate civilians from conflict zones. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units. 
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-02.name: Innocent Flesh and Blood
main_08-02.description:
In the tundras of Ursus, every living creature is under suspicion. They may be murderers, thugs, spies, or simply innocents. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units. 
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-03.name: Oatstalk, Easily Alight
main_08-03.description:
Righteous anger from witnessing such brutality is justified. Ursus's manglers are well-trained, and their fangs do not cease just because of their victims' emotions. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units. 
<@lv.item><Talulah, the Fighter></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-03#f#.name: Oatstalk, Easily Alight
main_08-03#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The DP Cost of Ranged units is doubled.

st_08-02.name: Silence, Born of Excessive Speech
st_08-02.description: Kal'tsit has never demonstrated impatience when explaining a story to others. She is either very good at controlling herself, or she actually enjoys it.

main_08-04.name: Sparks, Extinguished in a Touch
main_08-04.description:
Sometimes, protecting others is not a goal, but a process. Also, Ursus's crossbowmen also privately believe that killing others is not a goal, but a process. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

st_08-03.name: Death, Comes When Beckoned
st_08-03.description: In reality, just witnessing an atrocity is enough to make one become a part of it.

main_08-05.name: Cold, Only Perceived
main_08-05.description:
The lowest recorded temperatures of the Northwestern Tundras are sometimes not as bone-chilling as the words of certain individuals. 
<@lv.item><Talulah, the Fighter></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.
<@lv.item><FrostNova's Originium Ice Crystal></> Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold on affected enemy units.

main_08-05#f#.name: Cold, Only Perceived
main_08-05#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Ursus Raiders have significantly increased ATK and DEF.

st_08-04.name: Will, Phantom Wisps
st_08-04.description: All ideals, once transmitted, will eventually be corrupted or altered. Only through practice can an ideal be proven, and as we know, once something happens, it cannot be undone.

main_08-06.name: War, Sprawling Without Cease
main_08-06.description:
The mightiest and meekest both share the same tenacity. 
<@lv.item><Talulah, the Fighter></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.
<@lv.item><Patriot's Originium Altar></> Periodically releases gas in the surrounding tiles, inflicting heavy damage to enemies.

main_08-06#f#.name: War, Sprawling Without Cease
main_08-06#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Ursus Armored Casters have significantly increased attack range.

st_08-05.name: Ruination, Long Awaited
st_08-05.description: With enough effort, drops of water can pierce through stone. Everything you've experienced will coalesce into the truth and spread across this land.

main_08-07.name: Baptism by Tractor Fire
main_08-07.description:
Within the Ursus Army, the history of the Artillery Corps is not particularly lengthy. They are more than happy to arm themselves with the newest technology, and have little concern to spare for who their enemies are. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-07#f#.name: Baptism by Tractor Fire
main_08-07#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Imperial Artillery Targeteers have greatly increased HP.

main_08-08.name: The Heart, Fickle and Impermanent
main_08-08.description:
If you wish to prove yourself before a legend, you must first <@lv.sp>approach perfection</>. Only the commoners shall bleed. Only the noble shall face slander. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Talulah, the Fighter></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-08#f#.name: The Heart, Fickle and Impermanent
main_08-08#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Your units have significantly decreased ATK.

main_08-09.name: Farewell, to Reunite Once More
main_08-09.description: 07:29:28 Though some friends may be willing to share your pain, you should perhaps <@lv.sp>reach out to them</>. And some may never have been your friends in the first place.

main_08-09#f#.name: Farewell, to Reunite Once More
main_08-09#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Enraged Possessed Soldiers, Enraged Possessed Leaders, and Enraged Possessed Bonethrowers have increased ASPD.

main_08-10.name: Reunited, Only to Separate
main_08-10.description:
To lose. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-11.name: Silent Butcher
main_08-11.description:
The Empire of Ursus has lost many elites throughout its many wars, but is always able to cultivate more. Just as an empire should. 
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Deploy to block the enemy's route.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-12.name: Malediction, Bound for Retribution
main_08-12.description: She has not yet died, but she has already seen too much death.

main_08-12#f#.name: Malediction, Bound for Retribution
main_08-12#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Sarkaz Centurion Hosts have significantly increased lifesteal.

main_08-13.name: Snowfall, Blackening the Earth
main_08-13.description:
Yet, they do not regard anyone as an 'enemy.' The dead and the incompetent have never been among their ranks.
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Talulah, the Fighter></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

main_08-13#f#.name: Snowfall, Blackening the Earth
main_08-13#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Imperial Strikers and Elite Imperial Strikers have increased ATK and HP.

main_08-14.name: Awakening, a Dream's End
main_08-14.description: An origin, a purpose, a fate, a demise. A tragedy that claims the Herd, all of them. Who can truly <@lv.sp>choose</> their own life?

main_08-14#f#.name: Awakening, a Dream's End
main_08-14#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Toxic dust from Mephisto, 'The Singer,' deals significantly increased damage.

main_08-15.name: Ire, Flowing Wilderward
main_08-15.description: 'So I wish to make a wager with you.'

main_08-16.name: Behold, the Twilight Comes
main_08-16.description:
Memory and reality have both been completely released, and she knows her time has come. 
(Part of this story cannot be skipped the first time you experience it.)
<@lv.item><Heated Path></>Periodically deals great damage to any units on it.

main_08-16#f#.name: Behold, the Twilight Comes
main_08-16#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Talulah begins in the Enraged state.

main_08-17.name: Arise, Treading Through Flames
main_08-17.description:
06:26:33 <@lv.sp>Split flame with sword</>, defeat the past with the present, and confront the chaotic with one's self. Rage, and know no compromise. Rage, and keep no silence. 
<@lv.item><Energy Aggregate></>Releases fireballs in the four cardinal directions, dealing Arts damage and inflicting [Burning Breath] (Deals increasing True damage each second, but can be resisted)

main_08-17#f#.name: Arise, Treading Through Flames
main_08-17#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Summons: Energy Aggregates deal increased Arts damage.

descList.2: Every journey has a <@lv.sp>■</>, but this world knows no <@lv.sp>■</>.
descList.3: Every journey has a destination, but this world knows no end.

sub_04-1-1.name: Cluster-1
sub_04-1-1.description:
Make good use of the Active Originium in the middle of the battlefield and things will be much easier.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly

sub_04-1-2.name: Cluster-2
sub_04-1-2.description:
Enemies are coming from more directions. Still it's recommended to build your defense around the Active Originium.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly

sub_04-1-3.name: Cluster-3
sub_04-1-3.description:
The alien force has split into two. It may be a good choice to consume their HP by the Active Originium.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly

sub_04-2-1.name: Myriapoda-1
sub_04-2-1.description: Please be careful of the Originium Slugs in the south and the north and don't let them go through our defense.

sub_04-2-2.name: Myriapoda-2
sub_04-2-2.description: The battlefield is narrow this time. Please think carefully about where to deploy Operators.

sub_04-2-3.name: Myriapoda-3
sub_04-2-3.description: The battlefield is even narrower. It's recommended to upgrade Operators to get through it.

sub_04-3-1.name: Rage-1
sub_04-3-1.description: Please pay attention to the joint attack of enemy's Originium Slugs and alien elite Casters.

sub_04-3-2.name: Rage-2
sub_04-3-2.description: Scatter the Operators and use ranged Operators to take out the Originium Slugs from afar.

sub_04-3-3.name: Rage-3
sub_04-3-3.description: There is not much space for melee Operators this time. Try using Specialist Operators to cope with the tough enemies on the left.

sub_04-4-1.name: Stand Firm-1
sub_04-4-1.description: A large number of elite enemies have appeared. Please be careful.

sub_05-1-1.name: Entrenched-1
sub_05-1-1.description: The enemies continue their massed assault. Beware of the Wraiths sneaking in from above.

sub_05-1-2.name: Entrenched-2
sub_05-1-2.description: The situation in the field is getting more complicated. Carefully deploy melee Operators to stop the swarm of enemy Breakers.

sub_05-2-1.name: Biting Cold-1
sub_05-2-1.description: Well armored Frost Drones are causing havoc with our forces. Counter them with Caster Operators.

sub_05-2-2.name: Biting Cold-2
sub_05-2-2.description:
The enemy force is a mix of Arts Masters and Frost Drones making it increasingly difficult to handle. Make use of Sniper and Caster Operators and don't forget our Jammers! 
<@lv.item><Jammer></> can stop nearby enemy drones from firing, greatly reduce their speed, and prevent them from activating special abilities after being deployed.

sub_05-3-1.name: Panic-1
sub_05-3-1.description:
Possessed Soldier Leaders can regenerate faster and pose a serious threat. Take them out first. 
<@lv.item><Turrets></> periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

sub_05-3-2.name: Panic-2
sub_05-3-2.description:
Defense Crushers are enemy elite units specialized in defense. Their attacks can also stun our melee units. Take advantage of their slow moving speed to counter them. 
<@lv.item><Turrets></> periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

sub_05-4-1.name: Hover-1
sub_05-4-1.description:
A large number of unmanned enemy drones have appeared on this operation. Please take charge of the anti-air defense.
<@lv.item><Jammer></> Stops nearby enemy drones from firing, greatly reduces their speed, and prevents them from activating special abilities.

sub_05-4-2.name: Hover-2
sub_05-4-2.description: Enemies attack from different directions in this battle. Be careful of the large number of Casters that are approaching.

sub_05-4-3.name: Abnormality-1
sub_05-4-3.description: A number of possessed enemies have appeared during this battle. Please make sure to fortify your defenses.

sub_06-1-1.name: Condensation-1
sub_06-1-1.description: The Yeti Squadron is utilizing Infused Glacial Originium Slugs in their assault upon us. Please be careful of these aberrant creatures.

sub_06-1-2.name: Condensation-2
sub_06-1-2.description: A failure to handle the synergy between Infused Glacial Originium Slugs and Icecleavers will result in massive losses.

sub_06-2-1.name: Hoarfrost-1
sub_06-2-1.description: An attack from a large number of Infused Glacial Originium Slugs, followed by a wave of Icecleavers, will inflict catastrophic damage to insufficiently prepared squads.

sub_06-2-2.name: Hoarfrost-2
sub_06-2-2.description:
Surrounded by a harsh environment filled with Originium Ice Crystals and powerful Icecleavers, how are we to mount a response to this attack? 
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></>Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold to affected allied units.

sub_07-1-1.name: Ambush-1
sub_07-1-1.description:
Make good use of neural interference landmines to deal with guerillas that are difficult to injure through normal means.
<@lv.item><Interference Mine></>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

sub_07-1-2.name: Ambush-2
sub_07-1-2.description:
Use interference mines to establish a defensive line, expand our advantages, and accomplish our strategic goals.
<@lv.item><Interference Mine></>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

hard_05-01.name: Operation Inferno-1
hard_05-01.description:
The enemy is attacking with the full force of their drone armada! Proper use of Snipers and Casters is the key to victory. 
<@lv.item><Jammer></> can stop nearby enemy drones from firing, greatly reduce their speed, and prevent them from activating special abilities after being deployed.

hard_05-02.name: Operation Inferno-2
hard_05-02.description: The terrain on this battlefield is relatively simple, but beware of enemy Casters. Consider deploying units with high Arts Res to draw their fire or take advantage of the holes on the ground.

hard_05-03.name: Operation Inferno-3
hard_05-03.description:
The battlefield is full of winding roads and blanketed in a poisonous haze. These factors have greatly hindered our ranged Operators' effectiveness. Consider deploying more Medic Operators maintain consistent healing. 
<@lv.item><Poison Haze></> Operators lose HP constantly

hard_05-04.name: Operation Inferno-4
hard_05-04.description:
Faust has returned even stronger than before, and all Turrets on the field have been greatly enhanced. Plan your deployment positions and operators carefully to repel Faust's ferocious attack! 
<@lv.item><Turrets></> periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

hard_06-01.name: Operation Cocytus-1
hard_06-01.description: Elite enemy troops, as well as Enraged Possessed Soldiers, have launched an offensive against us. Please make use of the central road to mount an effective defense.

hard_06-02.name: Operation Cocytus-2
hard_06-02.description:
The Possessed Soldiers are launching a vicious two-pronged attack, and we must stay calm if we are to deal with the threat.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly.

hard_06-03.name: Operation Cocytus-3
hard_06-03.description: The location of the Infused Glacial Originium Slugs will pose a significant threat to our Operators. Please think carefully about how to deal with these troublesome creatures.

hard_06-04.name: Operation Cocytus-4
hard_06-04.description:
The fully empowered FrostNova has returned to the battlefield. Use your tactical acumen to endure the blizzard! 
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></>Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold to affected allied units.

hard_07-01.name: Operation Starfire-1
hard_07-01.description:
Guerilla warfare does not preclude a frontal attack. Such a battle almost always leads to a decisive victory or a marked defeat. In this open terrain, who will benefit from this battle?
<@lv.rem>In this battle, Operator deployment is not restricted by melee/ranged designations.</>
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Deploy to block the enemy's route

hard_07-02.name: Operation Starfire-2
hard_07-02.description: This war of attrition has sapped us of our energy, but only miserable defeat awaits us should we give up now. Hold on! There must be an opening in the enemy's assault...

hard_07-03.name: Operation Starfire-3
hard_07-03.description:
In a harsh environment, the side that better adapts to the conditions has more chances to seize victory. However, who can afford these kinds of sacrifices?
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.
<@lv.item><Interference Mine></>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

hard_07-04.name: Operation Starfire-4
hard_07-04.description:
If you've never seen their formation in the past, you will not understand why they were feared by all living creatures upon the battlefield. Perhaps there are people out there who can describe how Ursus crushed civilization itself...
<@lv.item><Originium Altar></>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.

hard_08-01.name: Operation Erebus-1
hard_08-01.description:
A precious yet fragile life. 
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

hard_08-04.name: Operation Erebus-4
hard_08-04.description:
An arrogant yet terrifying god. 
<@lv.item><Energy Aggregate></> Releases fireballs in the four cardinal directions, dealing Arts damage and inflicting [Burning Breath] (Deals increasing True damage each second, but can be resisted)
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

<@lv.fs>Abilities of Manfred: </>
Deals additional Necrosis, and recovers his [Military Training] effect significantly faster.

<@lv.item><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery></> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block. 
<@lv.fs>Abilities of Manfred:</>
 In his second form, his floating cannon will attack one additional target (if there are none, it will instead attack twice).

act2multi_rm01.name: Firing Line Escape
act2multi_rm01.description: Civilians never intrude onto the battlefield: the field finds them first. To escape intact, professional help may be required—in addition to some extraordinary luck.

act2multi_05.description:

act1halfidle_tr01.name: Wildland Outpost
act1halfidle_tr01.description: This place used to be one of our outposts on the edge of the barrens. Time, beasts, and scavengers have taken their toll, but it is a good starting point for a factory base that can support further expansion into the wildland.

act1halfidle_01.name: Ruined City
act1halfidle_01.description:
We found a scrapped plate of unknown affiliation. The marks of battle upon it show the reason it was abandoned. Exercise caution, as there may be more than meets the eye within.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores].

act1halfidle_02.name: Wailing Canyon
act1halfidle_02.description:
We found a canyon with roaring winds. The good news is that the area is rich in resources. The bad news is that the resources seem to have been placed there by someone, and that someone is after us.

<@level.highlight>[Ruins]</>When destroyed, turns its own tile into an [Outpost] (deployable for high ground units), with a chance to drop a Basic Armory Plug-in.
<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

act1halfidle_03.name: Collapsed Mines
act1halfidle_03.description:
We found a devastated mine. The trail of human remains extends from the collapsed tunnels all the way to the surface. It was no mundane mine accident that destroyed this place, and horror stories about shambling wanderers continue to be told.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

act1halfidle_04.name: Sedimentary Riverbed
act1halfidle_04.description:
We found a riverbed with a heavy sediment layer. The salt grains in the mud indicate that seawater was once present in the river. There may be more than just resources buried within the sediment.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

act1halfidle_05.name: Kaleidoscopic Nest
act1halfidle_05.description:
We found a colorful nest belonging to some kind of creature. Samples indicate that the colors are produced by an unusual scale powder, but the creature it came from does not appear in any known records. Its behavior and threat level are unknown at this time.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]

act1halfidle_06.name: Bone-Strewn Wilds
act1halfidle_06.description:
We found a wasteland littered with carcasses. This place is undoubtedly ruled by an apex predator. The abnormally high levels of Originium activity signify danger, but also the potential for rich Originium deposits.

<@level.highlight>[Rich Vein]</>Deploy a [Surveyor] on it to turn it into an [Originium Mine] that produces [Packaged Cores]
<@level.highlight>[Active Originium]</>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

act1halfidle_h01.name: Treacherous Karst
act1halfidle_h01.description: A treacherous environment filled with karsts and deep valleys. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. From above, it seems there are only a few stone columns strong enough to provide steady footing. Be careful about what's under your feet.

act1halfidle_h02.name: Treacherous Ditches
act1halfidle_h02.description: A treacherous environment where the ground is full of ditches. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Sharp claws have left their mark on the ground, perhaps trying to dig something up—or keep it hidden.

act1halfidle_h03.name: Treacherous Pass
act1halfidle_h03.description: A treacherous environment with tall peaks surrounding a pass. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Common sense indicates that this place is easy to defend and hard to attack, but there are many around these parts who do not operate according to common sense.

act1halfidle_h04.name: Treacherous Cliffs
act1halfidle_h04.description: A treacherous environment where the mountains are separated by sheer cliffs. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. The winding mountains beyond the cliffs have created a maze. What you believe to be the sound of thunder could very well be caused by falling rocks.

act1halfidle_h05.name: Treacherous Caverns
act1halfidle_h05.description: A treacherous environment of winding caves. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. The tunnel walls carry the sound of small critters moving as a pack, and there is rot and decay in the air.

act1halfidle_h06.name: Treacherous Spires
act1halfidle_h06.description: A treacherous environment of rock formations corroded by wind and sand. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. This place lacks many of the conditions necessary for life, but the bleached bones and blood trails demonstrate that life has established its own form of order in this place of death.

act1halfidle_h07.name: Treacherous City
act1halfidle_h07.description: A treacherous miasma-filled city ruin. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Catastrophe has caused these broken walls and roads to fade from the memories of those who built them, and a curse has befallen this place. The ruined city is a deadly trap, and we find ourselves in its presence.

act1halfidle_h08.name: Treacherous Lake
act1halfidle_h08.description: A treacherous, dried, collapsed lake bed. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. An enormous concrete dome is hidden beneath the bottom of the lake. An explosion of unknown cause has turned this heavily guarded base into a slaughter ground where it is every survivor for themselves, and deadly weapons unbound by rule or reason are now pointed at us.

act45side_st01.name: Red Light at the Crossroads
act45side_st01.description: The girl feels a daze in the drizzle. She wakes up to find herself in a different place.

act44side_st01.name: The Oni's Shadow
act44side_st01.description: 'You're not Madame Oni anymore... you're just an Oni, a Vicious Oni.'

act44side_tr01.name: Roiling Fate
act44side_tr01.description:
Every ring is a press of the Delete key in the mortal realm. You do not understand its language, but you always find out the next day that a fork in life that should have led to you has been quietly wiped away.
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated

act44side_01.name: The Yakuza Way
act44side_01.description:
The cleanup is done. Load the remains into the trunk, get in the driver's seat, and leave. Nothing in the rearview mirror. You are not being followed. Why, then, do you hear the sound of breathing from behind you?
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated

act44side_02.name: Tales of the Supernatural
act44side_02.description:
It is an ordinary evening. The video editor is doing overtime as usual. He spots a black shadow in the footage. As he plays it frame by frame, the black shadow slowly approaches with a smile on its face.
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated

act44side_03.name: Notice: Nighttime Runaway
act44side_03.description:
Rubble starts to move itself in a noisy street, revealing a black hole on the sidewalk, waiting for the fugitive to leap in.
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated

act44side_04.name: Hyakumonogatari
act44side_04.description:
Every page of the old diary records the name of a participant. When the last story is told, the last page is turned, and the last candle is blown out—
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated

act44side_tr02.name: Snowflake Screen
act44side_tr02.description:
Snowflake-like dots roil, like a trapped memory knocking on the screen from inside, looking for a way out. The agitation ceases, and a cold face emerges from the crack.
<@lv.item><Fate Striker></> Continuously summons 'Certain Fates' when activated
<@lv.item><Stress-Relief Helper></> Reflects 'Certain Fates', activated after some time

act44side_05.name: Legacy of Ruin

<@lv.item><Stress-Relief Helper></> Reflects 'Certain Fates', activated after some time

act44side_st02.name: Symmetry
act44side_st02.description: The audience bleeds on stage. The actor weeps in the audience box.

act44side_st03.description: She is a wayfarer at home. She has found her home as a wayfarer.

act44side_ex01.description:

act44side_sp02.name: Bounceback

act19mini_01.name: Seek Unity and Lose Routes
act19mini_01.description:
Roads lead in every direction, and the natures of all things are different. Why force unity and lose the spice of life?
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it gain a Hui-Ming Attribute.

act19mini_02.name: Seek Difference and Lose the Way
act19mini_02.description:
All rivers flow into the sea, and certain laws of the world need not be said. Why force difference, and lose sight of who you are?
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it gain a Hui-Ming Attribute.
<@lv.item><Mark of Dusk and Dawn></> On first passing through, enemies will change attribute.

act19mini_02#f#.name: Seek Difference and Lose the Way

act19mini_03.name: Seek the Distant and Lose the Near
act19mini_03.description:
A mountain is not climbed in a single step. Why focus so much on the big picture that you lose sight of the present?
<@lv.item><Farmland></> Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.

act19mini_04.name: Seek a Path and Lose the Goal
act19mini_04.description:
There are many dead ends, but mountains aplenty when you look up. Why focus so much on taking one step at a time that you forget your goal?
<@lv.item><Farmland></> Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.

act19mini_05.name: Seek Caution and Lose the Chance
act19mini_05.description:
It takes only a single night for a bamboo shoot to grow tall, and a day for an althea flower to fall. Why insist that everything be slow and steady, and let opportunity slip away?
<@lv.item><Yumen Catastrophe Defenses></> Units placed here deal more damage to ground units and take less damage from ground units
<@lv.item><Defensive Barricade></> Blocks multiple enemies

act19mini_06.name: Seek Speed and Lose Quality
act19mini_06.description:
Iron must be heated hundreds of times to become steel, and a great marsh takes thousands of years to dry. Why insist on reaching the target in a single leap, and compromise its quality?
<@lv.item><Yumen Catastrophe Defenses></> Units placed here deal more damage to ground units and take less damage from ground units
<@lv.item><Defensive Barricade></> Blocks multiple enemies

act19mini_07.name: Seek Harmony and Lose Ground
act19mini_07.description:
Trees form forests by competing with one another. Why insist on removing oneself from conflict, and end up losing what is most important?
<@lv.item><Farmland></> Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.
<@lv.item><Throttle Valve></> Stops Blight from spreading.
<@lv.item><Pumping Station></> Pumps water from one tile behind toward the front, cleansing or spreading Blight.

act19mini_08.name: Seek Progress and Lose an Out
act19mini_08.description:
When all the other beasts fought over prey, the fowl chose to abandon the ground for the skies. Why insist on not taking a single step back, and cutting of your own path of life?
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it will earn a Hui-Ming attribute
<@lv.item><Mark of Dusk and Dawn></> On first passing through, enemies will change attribute

act19mini_s01.name: Seek and You Shall Suffer
act19mini_s01.description:
All desires are about gain and loss. But what did you miss in between, and how much did you shoulder?
<@lv.item><Blood Ledger></> All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

act19mini_s02.name: Seek Not From the Outside
act19mini_s02.description: Come because of fate, which stems from the heart. Go along with one's heart, and let neither gain nor loss, nor love nor hate bind you, so that your heart and eyes are clear, lest you ever forget what you chose and why you chose it.

<color=#FFA300><Danger Zone> </color>Operators in the Danger Zone retreat at the end of the wave.

act43side_st01.description: Bow, and pay your respects to the eagerly awaiting audience. A fine show has already begun.

act1break_sp01.name: Why Rush?
act1break_sp01.description: Perhaps a slower pace will allow more time to appreciate the view.

act1break_sp02.name: No Time For Distractions
act1break_sp02.description: Trifling troublemakers are bound to show up whenever you're earnestly trying to solve a big issue!

act1break_sp03.name: Covering Fire
act1break_sp03.description: Things ought to be done one by one. The start is always the hardest, but get past it and it'll all be fine.

act1break_sp04.name: Gnawed-Out Holes
act1break_sp04.description: Don't be scared by these pests when they swarm around you. How will you know who is stronger without a proper fight?

act1break_sp05.name: Gnawbeast Tsunami
act1break_sp05.description: If you can't take it anymore, let someone else who can do it.

act1break_sp06.name: Consumption Choice
act1break_sp06.description: No matter how bad a situation may get, there's still time to act before it gets even worse.

act1break_sp07.name: Investment Returns
act1break_sp07.description: Pay a little, and you'll get something in return. But when exactly will you reap what you sow? Hard to say.

act1break_sp08.name: Venture Capital
act1break_sp08.description: It may be a pleasant surprise to win big with a small investment, but keep your guard up until you cash it in.

act1break_sp09.name: Long Journey
act1break_sp09.description: Sometimes you may feel busy, yet it feels as if nothing has gotten done.

act1break_sp10.name: Hurry Everywhere
act1break_sp10.description: Sometimes you may feel everyone else is busy, but you haven't got a clue what they're up to, and you start losing your mind.

act1break_sp11.name: Explosion Scene
act1break_sp11.description: It's best to pretend you're busy if you find yourself in a messy crowd.

act1break_sp12.name: Witchcraft Rehearsal
act1break_sp12.description: Difficult problems always coop up in one place.

act1break_sp13.name: Witchcraft Performance
act1break_sp13.description: Potential hiccups always happen more than you expect.

act1break_sp14.name: No Escape
act1break_sp14.description: When you hit a dead end, why not look at it from a different angle? Perhaps it's a starting point of not one, but many different paths.

act1break_sp15.name: Wall Opening
act1break_sp15.description: Once you realize you're in danger, don't just think about how to escape, but about when's the best time to do so.

act1break_sp16.name: One Way Out
act1break_sp16.description: But take note—even if you find out you slipped up on the timing, make sure you don't retrace your steps and go backward!

act1multi_rm01.description:

act1multi_rm07.description: Academics still argue over this: When trying to create as many organisms as possible within a short period of time, is it better to rely on creation Arts or reproductive instincts?

act1multi_01.description: Civilians never intrude onto the battlefield: the field finds them first. To escape intact, professional help may be required—in addition to some extraordinary luck.

Texas is intent on coming home, and someone is intent on stopping her.

act21side_01_t.name: Cittanova Main Street
act21side_01_t.description:
Mafiosi start fighting in a pizza parlor. Protect the patrons as they try to make an exit.
Texas still detests it all, but there is little she could do.

act21side_02_m.name: Carwash
act21side_02_m.description:
He dreams of a purge.
The joy in the dream was real. He could taste the excitement he felt. He wants to taste it again.

act21side_02_t.name: Saluzzo Estate
act21side_02_t.description:
Complete Alberto's mission.
Lappland knows that her father is testing her. He does not want to be disappointed. She has different ideas.

act21side_03_m1.name: Bellone Estate
act21side_03_m1.description:
There is a traitor within the Bellone famiglia. Feign injury and bait them.
Beware those disguised as doctors and judges. No one called them.

act21side_03_m2.name: Back Alley
act21side_03_m2.description:
She hooks a Saluzzo spy after a long wait.
Lappland giggles.

act21side_04_m1.name: Saluzzo Estate
act21side_04_m1.description:
Resentment for Lappland is building within the famiglia. They await her reaction.
She takes up arms.

act21side_04_m2.name: Volsinii Courthouse
act21side_04_m2.description:
Protect the civilians targeted by the mafiosi.
In Siracusa, the law represents the will of one. As the agent of that will, Lavinia finds herself struggling to protect ordinary citizens.

act21side_05_m1.name: Back Alley
act21side_05_m1.description:
A familiar sight at the fruit stalls.
Deal with those who are making deals without permission. The famiglie can have only one voice.

act21side_05_m2.name: Teatro di Milano
act21side_05_m2.description:
An ambush is laid around the theater. The assassination of Rossati is about to be carried out.
It is his master's orders. The chaos of the city continues. He must do everything for his famiglia.

act21side_05_t.name: Back Alley
act21side_05_t.description:
Pursue the arsonist.
Lappland knew they would justify the purge with the theft that occurred in the Saluzzo Estate a few days ago. But now that she knows, she does not want them to open their mouths again.

act21side_06_m.name: Penguin Logistics Office
act21side_06_m.description: The bustling streets fall silent at Texas's appearance. The people probe at one another, trying to entice her to leave. Anyone who tries to talk to her is taken down by another. Perhaps there is something they want to say to her, and she should act first.

act21side_06_t.name: Cittanova Main Street
act21side_06_t.description:

The conflict between the famiglie never ends, even for a carwash worker who only washed Alberto's car once.

Timely aid helps one remember who is truly on their side. They will remember Texas's act of kindness.

act1lock_a-01.name: Daybreak Point - Awareness
act1lock_a-01.description: 'Welcome, competitors. You will face your OpFor challenge for the first time here. Do not underestimate them, but do not be overly cautious either. In Minos, risky but efficient tactical thinking is most appreciated by the judges.'

act1lock_a-02.name: Daybreak Point - Ideal
act1lock_a-02.description:
Mt. Hymnoi is Minos's second highest point above sea level, and the legendary site where its heroes assembled.
Now, we stand on the very same ground as those heroes.

act1lock_a-03.name: Daybreak Point - Sense
act1lock_a-03.description:
The Interlocking Security Competition is one of the few events where Minos allows the Infected to compete in.
During it, such competing athletes are permitted only to spend their free time within competition bounds.
It is forbidden to leave the grounds without having obtained permission, on threat of coercive measures.

act1lock_a-04.name: Daybreak Point - Attribute
act1lock_a-04.description:
'You didn't know? Not long ago, the 'Goddess of Victory' emerged from nowhere, guiding the Minoans to repel those ferocious Sargon invaders...' 
'The 'Goddess of Victory' showed up, brought victory to the Minoans, and then simply left without a word. Such a missed opportunity... if her feats were formally recorded in the Hall of the Twelve Heroes, she would've been conferred great hero status, no doubt! And now all that's left for us is the legend to tell.'

act1lock_b-01.name: Daytime Ground - Conduct
act1lock_b-01.description:
This is the Garrison Team's first time splitting with the squad. Be alert for anything.
If you want to challenge the mighty OpFor on the Twilight Frontier, then you need to send a team to garrison here. Withdrawal from here means losing your right to challenge that one additional OpFor Unit.
Calm down. Think slowly. Rational personnel planning will reward you with greater points for an utmost advantage.
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal></>Deducts 1 Life Point if destroyed

<@tu.ht>Garrison Effect: <Hymnoi Hero> will proceed to the Twilight Frontier</>

act1lock_b-02.name: Daytime Ground - Illusion
act1lock_b-02.description:
'Hello? Hi, committee, we've been set up here for twenty minutes. Why has a judge still not come to certify? Quit slacking! Clock-out time is a mile away!'
'...How lazy can you Minoans be? How do you even have 'afternoon tea' in work hours?'

<@tu.ht>Garrison Effect: <Hymnoi Warrior> will proceed to the Twilight Frontier</>

act1lock_b-03.name: Daytime Ground - Meditation
act1lock_b-03.description:

Calm yourself. Drink some hot water.

act4d0_01.description:
Striking at precisely the right time is crucial to success in battle. And being able to recognize that timing is the difference between an effective commander and a footnote failure. 
<@lv.item><Stun Generator></> Pay a cost to activate it, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_01#f#.name: Ignition
act4d0_01#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The Speed of enemy units is increased significantly.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_02.name: Gathering
act4d0_02.description:
Just need a little push...
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on it are healed over time.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_02#f#.name: Gathering
act4d0_02#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
Operator deployment limit is reduced by 2.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_03.name: Speckles
act4d0_03.description:
When you exploit the terrain to your advantage, the enemy will seek to do the same. Be well aware, strategy is an art of action and reaction.
<@lv.item><Detector></> Once activated, it will reveal nearby invisible enemies for a period of time.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_03#f#.name: Speckles
act4d0_03#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The range of the enemy's ranged units is increased significantly.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_04.name: Sleight of Hand
act4d0_04.description:
If we could just lay out some bait...
<@lv.item><Heated Path></>Deals massive damage to Operators and enemies on it at intervals.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_04#f#.name: Sleight of Hand
act4d0_04#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The range of enemy abilities is greatly increased.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_05.name: Prolonged Destruction
act4d0_05.description:
Hinder the enemy's movements, delay the clash of forces, slow the pace of deployment, and realign the entire war.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

act4d0_05#f#.name: Prolonged Destruction
act4d0_05#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The recovery speed of Deployment Points is reduced by 33%.
<@act.timeLimit>Stage open from: 3/25 10:00 - 4/8 03:59</>

a001_01.name: High Noon
a001_01.description:
Sand is blowing wildly outside Kazimierz. Down from the abandoned gallows there is a greedy, cunning rioter, while behind him stands a knight who has just crossed the desert alone with nothing but the lance in her hand.
<@lv.rem>Some Operators cannot be deployed</>

a001_02.name: Sophistication
a001_02.description: People gather in the bar for all sorts of different reasons. They each have their own axe to grind, but after weighing the pros and cons, decide to work together over a few rounds of beer. However, before they can even take two steps out the door, the temporary truce falls apart violently. Such is the life of bounty hunters.

a001_03.name: An Unexpected Journey
a001_03.description:
Nobody is going to give up the treasure without a fight, and the troublemakers just keep coming one after another. Obviously, most of them have no idea what a 'fair fight' means.
<@lv.rem>Some Operators cannot be deployed</>

a001_04.name: Turn State's Evidence
a001_04.description:
Even more reliable than death and taxes is the unpredictability of life. It even works on your friends, your enemies, and even your own beliefs.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

a001_05.name: Different Opinions
a001_05.description:
It's said that no great fortune comes without sin, because the path to wealth is always paved with violence and bloodshed.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

a001_06.name: Golden Triangle
a001_06.description:
Everyone has their own path. You choose your path, while she chooses hers. Some roads may be more dangerous than others, but we all reach the same destination in the end.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

a001_ex01.name: True Grit
a001_ex01.description: These little critters that have crawled up from underground are extremely dangerous. Their homes have been destroyed as a result of the bounty hunters' rampant excavation, so all they know how to do now is to return the favor.

a001_ex02.name: No Country for Old Men
a001_ex02.description: The terrain is simple but the fighting is gritty. Useless traps and coins are scattered everywhere.

a001_ex04.name: The Treasure of the Kazimierz Mortica
a001_ex04.description:
It's annoying to dig for treasure underground, because you can never tell whether it's dirt or an Originium Slug that falls into your hair.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

a001_ex04#f#.name: The Treasure of the Kazimierz Mortica
a001_ex04#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The deployment cost of ranged Operators is tripled.

a001_ex05.name: Stagecoach
a001_ex05.description:
To seize victory, one must carve a bloody path through the defenses of their enemies. Our poor enemies.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

a001_ex05#f#.name: Stagecoach
a001_ex05#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The Attack Speed of all enemies is increased significantly.

a001_ex06.name: Once Upon a Time in the West
a001_ex06.description:
Heavily armed enemies are constantly pouring in from all directions. It's not their fault — you blocked the only way out, after all.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Deploy to block the enemy's route

a001_ex06#f#.name: Once Upon a Time in the West
a001_ex06#f#.description:
<@lv.fs>Condition:</>
The cost of Roadblocks is tripled.

camp_01.name: Chernobog
camp_01.description:
Annihilate the large number of Reunion mobs in Chernobog. Watch out for the leaders patrolling the area.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_02.name: Lungmen Outskirts
camp_02.description:
Annihilate the dangerous Reunion mobs lurking in the outskirts of Lungmen, and ensure that no threat is posed to the safety of the city.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_03.name: Lungmen Downtown
camp_03.description:
Annihilate the Reunion armed forces that have invaded Lungmen, and regain initiative within the region.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_01.name: The Grand Knight Territory Outskirts
camp_r_01.description:
A large-scale competitive exhibition game organized by the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce. As a defender, Rhodes Island must make use of sponsor drones to deal with the Knightclubs' elites.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_02.name: Frozen Abandoned City
camp_r_02.description:
Well-organized Reunion guerrillas are hiding in this abandoned nomadic city in the tundra of Ursus. Be prepared for the deathly chill, as that is your only hope for victory.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_03.name: Abandoned Mine
camp_r_03.description:
A remote mine in Ursus where the Infected Patrol Unit are hunting down the Infected. Make good use of the tricky terrain to buy time for the Infected to escape.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally and failing to save an Ursus civilian will result in a penalty of -1 annihilation count.

camp_r_04.name: Flooded Seashore
camp_r_04.description:
An unassuming beach on the coastline of Siesta currently overrun by Sicilians and rioters. Utilize the Command Terminals provided by the city of Siesta and apprehend them posthaste.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_05.name: Watery Tidehollow
camp_r_05.description:
As the tides surge, the Seaborn grow restless deep within a vast cavern. With the help of the remaining Iberian machines there, eliminate the Seaborn threat once and for all.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally

camp_r_06.name: Long Spring Wastes
camp_r_06.description:
After the 'Watchtower 33' incident, some 'Redmark' mercenaries avoided Rhodes Island's pursuit while controlling the remnant Originiutant mutants. If these organisms are allowed to escape to other areas, the outcome would be disastrous. Please carry out a thorough extermination.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Sandstorm></> Allied units caught inside the sandstorm will have reduced ATK, continuously take damage over time, and have extended redeployment time; Enemy units will instead be slowed

camp_r_07.name: Dossoles Water Gate
camp_r_07.description:
Lady Candela recently invested in two Leithanian 'Gramophones.' She hopes that Rhodes Island will participate in a joint exercise with the Dossoles Defense Squad to test out the point-defense capabilities of the 'Gramophones.'
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><'Gramophone'></> Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies.

camp_r_08.name: South Prison
camp_r_08.description:
The convict Jesselton, having been transferred from Mansfield State Prison, has incited a prison riot, aided by the local Siracusan gangs who decided to join in. Rhodes Island must intervene immediately and put down the insurrection using the Imprisonment Devices. 
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Imprisonment Device></>Imprisons freed enemies within its effect area.

camp_r_09.name: County Hillock Countryside
camp_r_09.description:
After accepting a commission from Victoria, Rhodes Island sets out to deal with Spectre Force active in the County Hillock countryside.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar> </>Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

camp_r_10.name: Night Champion Show
camp_r_10.description:
A corporation in Kazimierz is planning an unusual game show. Participants must fend off wave after wave of knight attacks in order to claim the grand prize. Rhodes Island has been invited as a contestant. 
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally. 
<@lv.item><City Neon></> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used

camp_r_11.name: Lingering Shangshu Trails
camp_r_11.description:
Wares of all shapes and sizes have once again appeared on the twisting mountain paths. Are they seeking the goblet which once granted them sentience, which was subsequently cast from the mountains? The relevant bureaus in Yan have requested Rhodes Island's assistance in this matter.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_12.name: Chocolate Street
camp_r_12.description:
The Summit of Nations is over, and Pathfinders that have not left with the Guide remain in Laterano, trying to restore faith there in their own way. They have caused a disturbance in the commercial area of the Stevonus district, and the Notarial Hall has requested help from Rhodes Island.
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><'Gelato Stop'></>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies

camp_r_13.name: Penumbra Shipyards
camp_r_13.description:
The shipyard that built ships such as the Stultifera Navis has become a nest of Sea Terrors. The Inquisition has contracted Rhodes Island to eliminate them in order to salvage a Golden Age ship-of-the line that is still restorable.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Hand of the Saint - Purification Mode></> Bounces a 'Hand of the Saint' in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with, and clearing Nethersea Brand in its path.

camp_r_14.name: Research Base Hangar
camp_r_14.description:
The prototype power armors stored in Test Site 359's hanger have suddenly reactivated during the cleanup work. The Rhodes Island operators present must quickly intervene and bring this incident to a close.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><R-Series Power Armor></>Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

camp_r_15.name: Lungmen Commercial District
camp_r_15.description:
At the behest of the Rat King, the local Siracusan mafia contacted a number of mercenaries, preparing to bring joy to the city during Sauin. But before they do so, they need to rehearse with Rhodes Island's operators to ensure no civilians are harmed. 
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Mobile Tactical Hangar> </>Deploys drones as needed to assist enemy combatants. 
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal> </>Depletes 1 Life Points when destroyed.

camp_r_16.name: Rest Avenue
camp_r_16.description:
A renowned musician is holding a charity concert, but intel indicates that troublemakers have infiltrated the audience, disguised as the Witch King's Remains. Operators are to act promptly to ensure that the concert is held smoothly.
<@lv.rem><Condition> </>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Waste Energy Interference> </>Natural SP recovery rate reduced.
<@lv.item><Realigned Flux> </>Restores natural SP recovery rate of allied Operators within.

camp_r_17.name: Ashy Marsh
camp_r_17.description:
With the flame called resentment cast into those overgrown reeds, the ashes quickly make their pursuit of those trekking through their homeland. Having heard their pleas for help, Rhodes Island will not stand idly by.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Mire></>Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within.
<@lv.item><Reeds></>Operators within gain Camouflage.

camp_r_18.name: 'The Special Little Aquapit'
camp_r_18.description:
The Durins who miss 'The Great Aquapit' so much have constructed new aquatic amusement facilities on the surface. All the tribes of Acahualla have received invitations to join the carnival, and crates of alcoholic beverages are being delivered...Rhodes Island, please, lend a hand in maintaining order!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_19.name: Decaying Wastes
camp_r_19.description:
The armies of the Nachzehrer ravage the fields, turning fertile farmland to barren wastes. Send a squad to repel them, and give a sliver of hope to the people of Londinium, who have suffered for too long.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Twigs That Crave></> Produces Rot Eaters when destroyed or at the end of the stage.

camp_r_20.name: Mountain-Ringed Border Town
camp_r_20.description:
Roaming bandits have come together again, planning an attack on a weakly defended mountain pass. 
<@lv.rem><Condition> </>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Yumen Catastrophe Defenses> </>Units placed here deal more damage to low ground units and take less damage from low ground units.
<@lv.item><Defensive Barricade> </>Blocks multiple enemies.

camp_r_21.name: New Hotel Avenue
camp_r_21.description:
Tourists never stay here, but they do leave with its song and wine. They even want to take with them those soft and fluffy dreams, but those have already melted away in yesterday's evening breeze. Do you see those fluffy creatures? Let's chase after them together, one more time.
<@lv.rem><Condition></>DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Decorative Geyser></>Units standing around it are unaffected by vapor, and will produce White Vapor when attacking
<@lv.item><Steam Soda Bottles></>When defeated, creates Pure White Steam in the surrounding area

camp_r_22.name: 'Eccentricity' Laboratory
camp_r_22.description:
Gravity, visibility, trajectory. An arclight builds a bridge at the crossroads of fate, within the erratic everything. Somewhere not far from the land, we shall overcome cowardice and hubris together. We remember, we hold fast, we advance without looking to the past.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Gravity Switch></> Gravity Switches and Planetary Debris: Moves along a set path, blocking lanes and dealing physical damage to units they touch. Can be moved by your units in adjacent tiles.

camp_r_23.name: Burning District
camp_r_23.description:
This is not only their war, but ours too! Taking back Londinium means taking back every room, street, and neighborhood in our memories. Forward, forward!
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> </>Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block.

camp_r_24.name: Icebound Valley
camp_r_24.description:
Blizzards, heaters, and frost-covered burdenbeasts. Rhodes Island, a delegation, and the snowy valleys of Kjerag. Those who couldn't get their fill of excitement on the frozen lake have gathered in a secluded spot for a fierce showdown. Unfortunately, they've disturbed the peaceful slumber of the burdenbeasts.
<@lv.rem><Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Emergency Heater></> Makes surrounding Operators immune to the Frigid environmental effect.

camp_r_25.name: Cityway 66
camp_r_25.description:
A cityway that once carried pioneers and hope as it stretched further and further west. Once. Now, the promises of the past have faded. The facilities once full of promise have fallen into disrepair, leaving only an invitation echoing over the airwaves: to clear out enemies.
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions> </>DP will not regenerate naturally
<@lv.item><Waste Heat Vent> </>Deals Arts damage to both enemies and allies and reduces enemies' Movement Speed, but will charge their energy.

camp_r_26.name: Paddy Field 9-7
camp_r_26.description:
These hundred mu of fragrant fields and paddies are also the hope of farmers who dream of a future without famine. Vermin encroach once more, and blight has begun to pollute the crops. We ask Rhodes Island for aid in protecting the harvests of these hard-working farmers!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.</>
<@lv.item><Farmland> </>Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.

camp_r_27.name: Kurfürstenplatz
camp_r_27.description:
The 'Echoes of Herkunftshorn'—they seek to carry on the Witch King's melody. Play now, rescue team from Rhodes Island; drown out the chaotic, resentful, and paranoid notes with your own melody. The Kurfürstenplatz should witness the most beautiful sunset.
<@lv.rem><Special Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally.</>
<@lv.item><Tuning Node></>Heals when attacked; when activated during a song variation, changes the variation and briefly applies a buff to friendly units.

camp_r_28.name: Grand Bazaar
camp_r_28.description:
Brazen sand bandits have accidentally awakened the sleeping exhibits while trying to rob the museum. Restore order to the streets!
<@lv.rem><Special Conditions></> DP will not regenerate naturally.

camp_r_29.name: Saltfin Graveyard
camp_r_29.description:
A caravan searching for artifacts from the Golden Age has accidentally stumbled upon a saltfin nest. The vicious saltfins have them pinned down in the Salt Flat, while dastardly pirates are closing in on them with their salt ships. They've been sending distress signals to Rhodes Island the entire time, so go and save them already!
<@lv.rem><Special Condition></> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<@lv.item><Salt Flat></> Enemies passing through have reduced Movement Speed; after stopping for long enough, they will sink in and be defeated
<@lv.item><Saltheap Cannon></> Periodically fires a shell forward, dealing Physical splash damage; can launch a nearby ground enemy of 3 Weight or less to the center of the explosion

lt_tr_01.name: Training Ground #7
lt_tr_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>A training field specially built by Rhodes Island for the Security Drill, it simulates the mine area in a basic manner.

lt_tr_02.name: Training Ground #9
lt_tr_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>A training field specially built by Rhodes Island for the Security Drill, it simulates the mine area's terrain in greater detail.

lt_tr_03.name: Training Ground #10
lt_tr_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>A training field specially built by Rhodes Island for the Security Drill, it simulates the mine area's environment in extraordinary detail.

lt_05_01.name: The Swarming Masses
lt_05_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>For the thugs in the barrens, the important thing isn't who snatches the steak, but who gobbles it down before anyone else can do anything about it.

lt_05_02.name: Passing Down the Profit
lt_05_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Not a single Siracusan famiglia will sit idly by while someone else monopolizes a lucrative industry. Though the times have changed, their profit-driven hearts have not.

lt_05_03.name: Industrial Improvement
lt_05_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>As the mastermind behind the theft of the under-construction plate, Sandel knows how to keep abreast of the times. However, after purchasing cutting-edge technology and the latest know-how from Kazimierz, his coffers - stretched thin to begin with - have ended up dry.

lt_05_04.name: Bad Company
lt_05_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>It is not as if Ms. Candela had not considered shadier methods before reaching out to Rhodes Island. But in the eyes of the special detachment she sent, her way of greasing palms seemed like pocket change compared to the windfall Sandel promised.

lt_05_05.name: Tipsy Trip
lt_05_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>Afterwards, thanks to Pozëmka's appeals to emotion and Gavial's appeals to reason, the Durins finally agreed to cut down on the amount they drink—at least enough to not randomly follow other people around after one round.

lt_05_06.name: A Piece of Steak
lt_05_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>The grown-up Sandel no longer has to cry in the locker room after losing a fight over some lunch money. Because he's smart enough, brave enough, and mean enough, he still has a way out.

lt_05_01_ex.name: The Swarming Masses
lt_05_01_ex.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>For the thugs in the barrens, the important thing isn't who snatches the steak, but who gobbles it down before anyone else can do anything about it.

lt_06_01.name: Jungle Greetings
lt_06_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Tiacauhans are no stranger to the fistful method of saying hello, and neither are you.

lt_06_02.name: Biodiversity
lt_06_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Confronted with a swarm of Infected creatures, you notice some rarer species among them—but you don't have time to worry about that, because there are also a bunch of belligerent Tiacauhans in the mix.

lt_06_03.name: Adaptation
lt_06_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>After seeing Acahualla's overblown ecosystem for yourself, you no longer care to express your opinion on the good-for-nothings getting chummy with the Infected creatures.

lt_06_04.name: Glade
lt_06_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>You find a clearing in the jungle, clear the Originium slugs from it, and plan to let the team rest up here. However, your actions seem to have gotten in the way of a group of outsiders who had a similar idea.

lt_06_05.name: Not Letting Go
lt_06_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>The outsiders' persistent attacks are getting on your nerves. You decide to crush them first, before dealing with whatever caused the rainforest to flourish out of control.

lt_06_06.name: Man And Nature
lt_06_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>You thought you'd seen everything in Acahualla, but nature's wild side always has a way of leaving you dumbfounded. Facing the extremely aggressive sea of flowers before you, all you can do is pray not to sneeze TOO much.
