lt_07_01.name: I Know the Risks
lt_07_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Disgruntled former employees have made numerous holes in the plate, and one must be careful not to fall into them. Still, there will always be those who try to profit in the midst of the chaos.

lt_07_02.name: Barrenlands Business
lt_07_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>The denizens of the barrens often make use of Infected creatures, striking the fear of Oripathy into their enemy's hearts.

lt_07_03.name: Numb Way Forward
lt_07_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>What is truly frightening is not the hidden danger, but the numbness. Those who keep their heads bowed will inevitably lose their way on the winding path.

lt_07_04.name: Chaotic Party
lt_07_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>The onlooking drunkards decided they wanted in on the action, riding their boats into the fray. Perhaps you should ask Lady Candela to be more mindful about enforcing good behavior next time.

lt_07_05.name: Messenger
lt_07_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>The enemy arrived as soon as you found a good place to make a stand. Are there creatures amongst the attacking mutants able to share information with one another?

lt_07_06.name: Show of Power
lt_07_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Free from her former employer's restrictions, Mama's 'Rebel Girl' is setting up all sorts of dangerous traps and weapons. Does Mama feel regret at losing such a talent, or sad at the bedlam that she is causing?

lt_08_01.name: Fatal Attraction
lt_08_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>The noxious industrial gas has attracted Infected creatures. They will not leave until the bandit releasing the gas is stopped.

lt_08_02.name: Drunk Hammer
lt_08_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>The only thing more annoying than a drunkard is a drunkard with a heavy hammer, especially when the noxious gas has made them even more impaired.

lt_08_03.name: For Survival
lt_08_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>Mercenaries sometimes accept contracts for weapons testing, and these ones have mistaken you for the bandits occupying the platform.

lt_08_04.name: Mixed Gas
lt_08_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>Sarkaz withering mixes with the poison gas to create a suffocating combination. Take care of things quickly before you run out of time.

lt_08_05.name: Nurturing Wither
lt_08_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>Strange plants, if they can even be called that, are slowly stretching their branches out in the shadows. The gas does not seem to affect them; in fact, they seem to be nurturing something...

lt_08_06.name: Suffocation
lt_08_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>There is no length to which these wasteland bandits will not go, even releasing poison gas to capture a platform. The colorful protective suit seems to be declaring his victory.

lt_09_01.name: Iced Shells
lt_09_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>You never knew that the sweet, delectable icing of your favorite desserts could be this hard until these rioters stood before you with their iced shields.

lt_09_02.name: Sweet Party
lt_09_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>You accidentally stumble upon the sweets thieves gorging themselves on their loot. Before you can decide whether to say hello or leave quietly, they have already spotted you, leaving you with no choice but to join in.

lt_09_03.name: Cheesy Lockdown
lt_09_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>To stop the surging waves of invaders from damaging the interior of the platform, you must stand your ground here and put a stop to their onslaught. The hard cheese is going to help... probably.

lt_09_04.name: Advanced Artisanship
lt_09_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>The advanced production lines that the technological department keeps boasting about are already covered in ice cream by the time you got here. Before you can even save the usable parts, the next wave of chaos has already arrived.

lt_09_05.name: Cream Overflow
lt_09_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>You breathe a sigh of relief when you see the Originium slugs not moving at all, but when you identify their specific species and discover the cans of cream all around them, you understand that an intense defensive battle is about to unfold.

lt_09_06.name: Smile Guaranteed
lt_09_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Nobody can refuse such sweet smiles, especially not when they're charging toward you at full speed. But to get your hands on the limited edition waffle ice cream that the client promised, you know what you have to do.

lt_10_01.name: Sea Waves
lt_10_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>You swing open the door, and the ice cold sea breeze immediately surges into your lungs along with a hard-to-bear stench. Although it is somewhat different from how you remember it, you are familiar with this smell.

lt_10_02.name: Walking Dead
lt_10_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>The explorers who disappeared are all here. Their eyes are lifeless, and they start walking toward you unsteadily. You can feel no signs of life from them whatsoever, and your mind wavers at the sight.

lt_10_03.name: Banishment
lt_10_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>A group of colorfully-dressed explorers pours in from the pried-open door, with no idea of the dangers awaiting them. You must get them out of here, by force if necessary.

lt_10_04.name: Mirage
lt_10_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>Under the intense mental stimulation, you feel as though you are standing in another land entirely. You must break free of this illusion. This is your only escape.

lt_10_05.name: Fierce Currents
lt_10_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>Even back in reality, you have no time for rest. The horrifying scene is now conspicuous before your eyes. You are but one step from the truth, provided you can overcome the obstacle before you.

lt_10_06.name: Receding Tides
lt_10_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Its shell is as cold as the sea, and its lumens as hollow as the deep abyss. Its humanborn destiny ended when it stepped into the sea, long ago. It no longer belongs here, and it must not be allowed to remain.

lt_11_01.name: Patrolling Task
lt_11_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>The drones hover silently in the air, their cameras capturing everything happening below. They might be monitoring the movements of unwelcome visitors, but more likely they are focused on the artificial cream pies everyone is holding.

lt_11_02.name: Glade Collaboration Task
lt_11_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Deploying both aerial and ground assets at once can greatly improve agricultural production efficiency as well as yield excellent results in weed reduction. 'In that case, we just gotta set those guys as the target. I mean, what's the difference?'

lt_11_03.name: Irrigation Task
lt_11_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>Using drones to automate irrigation is among Tower Mountains's proudest inventions and patents. A variety of presets were prepared for the users upon the system's release. Of course, one could use it for more than just water and pesticides.

lt_11_04.name: Sowing Task
lt_11_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>There are many factors to consider when sowing seeds properly. For example, the diameter of the seeder, the speed and direction the seeds are launched, how deep they are buried in the soil, the destructive power against tough soil... The system is highly advanced. As such, it can function normally even if the seeds are swapped out for something else.

lt_11_05.name: Crowding Task
lt_11_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>'Watch out! The anti-crowd defense mode is still in the experimental stage, and currently only suitable for exterminating large crowds of pests. There is a serious risk of catastrophic malfunction! Do not use against humans! Do not use against humans!'

lt_11_06.name: Clearing Task
lt_11_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>'Why? Why can't you people pay attention to what you eat? Instead of healthy and nutritious vegetables, you eat all these terrible processed foods! This is a disgrace to agriculture! I... I'll throw all of you off this platform!'

lt_12_01.name: Disturbance's Beginning
lt_12_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>It seems somebody switched out all the sparkling water in the vending machines for alcohol. Before the match even started, the spectators in the stands had already started brawling, their faces beet red. A disturbance is brewing.

lt_12_02.name: Pronounced Cheering
lt_12_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>To put a damper on the home team fans whose morale is at an all-time high, a group of away team fans disguised themselves as Sarkaz mercs and rushed into the venue, causing large-scale panic. With most of the spectators fled, they have, in a sense, accomplished their goal.

lt_12_03.name: Breaking Barriers
lt_12_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>'Couldn't get tickets, but still want to see your favorite robotic stars from up close? No problem! Just don this menacing-looking getup and make your way to the venue. Storm the place as soon as you hear the signal. They can't stop all of us!'

lt_12_04.name: Growing Vociferation
lt_12_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>You can never tell what a group of fervent fans are capable of, especially when they've just gotten their hands on the latest thermal amplification devices. The good news is that all the proceeds from the sale of confiscated equipment will go toward rebuilding the now-molten spectator stands.

lt_12_05.name: Bleachers Outrush
lt_12_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>Even though they were absolutely destroyed in the arena, the robots' pilot is moved to tears by the encouragement of his cheering fans. He changes course with no regard for anything, and dashes straight toward the stands to embrace his passionate fans.

lt_12_06.name: Acahuallan Peak
lt_12_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>'Ladies and gentlemen, as well as all the liquor maniacs and mead fans trading blows in the stands! The highly anticipated grand finals are about to begin! Stick around and find out who will reach the Acahuallan Peak—Now hold on there, dear contestant. It's not time yet—Ahh!!'

lt_13_01.name: Allegro Lamentoso
lt_13_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Music abruptly fills the ears of the visitors, woven with an unmistakable thirst for recognition.

lt_13_02.name: Sonata Triste
lt_13_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>The loom creaks and the scissors snip, their morbid melodies clear and penetrating.

lt_13_03.name: Adagio Dolente
lt_13_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>The sorrow is infectious, and the Arts' grim influence undeniable. The Count slows his tempo, but pours even more emotion into his haunting performance.

lt_13_04.name: Minuetto Doloroso
lt_13_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>The count waves his needle as baton, and plucks the shuttles as strings. With shuttle and loom, he weaves your doom.

lt_13_05.name: Andante Lacrimoso
lt_13_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>'Transpose up!' 'No, down!' He ignores the voices shouting in his head. 'Let's do both, all at once!'

lt_13_06.name: Rondo Mesto
lt_13_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Warning: The following 'pieces' may cause extreme discomfort for some. Beware the howling Count and his squeaky gramophones.

lt_14_01.name: Unruly Escape
lt_14_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Metal beads cascade from the pachinko machine and tumble into the passage with flashing red lights—only to be blocked by an unruly creature.

lt_14_02.name: Citywide Bounty
lt_14_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Bent on catching those unruly creatures, Box Inc. has issued a very handsome citywide bounty. Rumors also speak of a secret weapon.

lt_14_03.name: 'Prize Claim'
lt_14_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>'No. Next.' 'Not this either. Next... what did you say? You can catch them all with this machine?'

lt_14_04.name: Freebie Frenzy
lt_14_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>Rumors of a big giveaway have people flocking to the streets. But why are there fewer and fewer people around?

lt_14_05.name: 'Shopping Spree'
lt_14_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>'They say it's for today only! Don't miss it—' The one at the head of the crowd disappears before he could finish his sentence.

lt_14_06.name: Grab 'Em All
lt_14_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Three, two, one. The claw machine show begins.

lt_15_01.name: Casters' Charge
lt_15_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Magic survives in the ruins and rubble. It cannot be completely erased, not even in the barren wilderness.

lt_15_02.name: Glory and Honor
lt_15_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Wealth, victory, survival, death. Away from home and on the battlefield, there are too many words that serve as proof of glory.

lt_15_03.name: Main Attack Channel
lt_15_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>'Sir! The terrain ahead is winding and rugged, with only one passage, and residual traces of Arts have been found in the environment. Should we continue to advance in formation?'

lt_15_04.name: Massive Swarm
lt_15_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>'Bugs! Bugs everywhere! Wait! They ate my biscuits! My Victorian biscuits! I'll smash them all to bits!'

lt_15_05.name: The Advance of the Flesh
lt_15_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>Fresh blood is the war tune, and flesh and bones form the walls against the enemy. Even if they have dried and vanished, mysterious Arts can still summon them when needed.

lt_15_06.name: Oblivion and Outcry
lt_15_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Please note: 'I hope to collect some samples of the interference sources, for science. Note: The paper can be co-authored.' A professor included this request in the letter of authorization.

lt_15_01_ex.name: Casters' Charge
lt_15_01_ex.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>Magic survives in the ruins and rubble. It cannot be completely erased, not even in the barren wilderness.

lt_16_01.name: Blinders
lt_16_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>Alleys of painted jade, city the scent of balm.

lt_16_02.name: Mountainous Maze
lt_16_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>'Midst rock and rotten tree, what of right, what of wrong?

lt_16_03.name: Another Town
lt_16_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>A garden bare but walled, a lantern cold and dark.

lt_16_04.name: Season's End
lt_16_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>Near comes the season's end, I mourn its fading light.

lt_16_05.name: The Windy Grove
lt_16_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>'Gainst one so true of heart, who dares speak triumph's name?

lt_16_06.name: Do Not Follow Tracks
lt_16_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Come fall a rising wind, spare no time seeking tracks.

lt_17_01.name: First Movement of the Barrens
lt_17_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>The music plays on, entrancing the beasts from the barrens to its enchanting melody. For anyone daring to stop their howling and dancing, fangs and claws await!

lt_17_02.name: Arrangement of the Statue
lt_17_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>Music-lovers, brimming with excitement, tell Rhodes Island they only modified the abandoned Gramophones. None dared touch the fearsome colossi—except one. A hand rises in the crowd. 'I… might have tweaked one to play an instrument. I thought it would be fine…'

lt_17_03.name: Rhapsody of the Wild
lt_17_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>Whether you're a carnivore, herbivore, or omnivore—here, we are all one! Raise your paws, hooves, or wings, and let the music set your artistic passion free!

lt_17_04.name: Lullaby of the Tame
lt_17_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>Ah, burdenbeasts—so tame, so meek. Drawn by the lullaby, they sway gently to the music, placidly munching on grass. Even as the music drives them to madness, they remain ever so tame.

lt_17_05.name: Duet of Beast and Statue
lt_17_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>The stone constructs and burdenbeasts dance together to the music, the grinding of rock and the sound of chewing forming a perfect rhythm. The music-lovers erupt with excitement: 'Music transcends species—and even the boundary between the living and the lifeless!'

lt_17_06.name: 'Heart of Music'
lt_17_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Years later, people still recall the wild concert where beasts and stone constructs sang in harmony under the open sky. Yet the music-lovers secretly lament: 'If only the drones hadn't been shot down—we would have loved to see if they, too, had hearts of music!'

lt_18_01.name: In the Alley
lt_18_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0
</color>The drunkard exclaims that his drink is so strong, it makes him see creatures he has never seen before. Then, he gets knocked over by a Bitey.

lt_18_02.name: By the Heights
lt_18_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1
</color>The scholar sees the lifelike statue on the rockery, and starts to dedicate a poem to it. Then, he finds to his shock that the statue and rockery have begun to move.

lt_18_03.name: Graveside
lt_18_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2
</color>The cemetery watchman gazes upon the night marketplace. It seems busier than usual tonight, louder, and yet so far from where he stands. Then, he looks down again—the earth itself is starting to stir.

lt_18_04.name: On Stage
lt_18_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3
</color>The ringmaster bows in front of the burning flames, confident that tonight's show will be one for the ages. Then, he hears footsteps that he did not expect.

lt_18_05.name: Under the Gates
lt_18_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4
</color>The officer frowns. These entities are strange, but seemingly harmless as they search for something. Then, he hears the sound of bells in the distance...

lt_18_06.name: Between Heaven and Earth
lt_18_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5
</color>Du Yaoye sighs as she watches the confused yet constantly moving figure of 'Aubade'. She quietly laments how these objects seem more human than some humans. But there is no home for it between heaven and earth. It is time to send it back.

lt_19_01.name: Bullets and Booze
lt_19_01.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 0</color>
The Galería's walls have been toppled and turned into bar tables for a barbecue shop. Enjoy your drink, but any drunkard who causes trouble will quickly discover how 'hospitable' the owner can be.

lt_19_02.name: Graffiti Kitchen
lt_19_02.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 1</color>
The kitchen door has been heavily spray-painted, almost as colorfully as the food the owner prepares inside. Enjoy your food, but people who try to wipe the graffiti away will quickly discover how 'hospitable' the owner can be.

lt_19_03.name: Thermostat Boiler
lt_19_03.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 2</color>
The boiler cobbled together from military steel is one of the proudest works of the street artists. Feel free to take a photo, but the diners have their way of dealing with jerks who turn the temperature down.

lt_19_04.name: Freezer Container
lt_19_04.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 3</color>
Street artists who have spent their entire lives in hot climate interpret 'cold' with Ursus-style designs, and the owner obliges by giving his container a fresh outlook. The street artists have their way of dealing with big-mouths who try to incite conflict.

lt_19_05.name: Sizzling Rack
lt_19_05.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 4</color>
The massive metal plate can grill a dozen steaks at the same time. The owner only takes it out for barbecue parties. The hot splashing oil has a way of dealing with anyone who tries to steal the meat.

lt_19_06.name: Special Customer
lt_19_06.description:
<color=#FF4200>Starting Danger Level: 5</color>
The intercity net servers that communicate instructions are long gone, but the security robot continues to operate according to its local logic. It has many ways of dealing with those who dare to deface the Galería's walls.

lt_01_01.name: Mine #5
lt_01_01.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>0
A small group of engineers of unknown origin have hidden themselves in the abandoned mine. Upon discovery by picket officers, both sides fell into conflict, hindering the cleanup of the mine.

lt_01_02.name: Mercenary
lt_01_02.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>1
Several infamous mining contractors found themselves chased out of Siesta after multiple violations the Obsidian trading laws. Apparently they haven't learned anything from the debacle though, as they plot to continue their actions elsewhere.

lt_01_03.name: Evil Forces
lt_01_03.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>2
The local gangs and scoundrels seem to have their eye on the mine, regularly coming over to 'see what they can help with.' These people are harder to shake off than a hound.

lt_01_04.name: Ineffectual Organization
lt_01_04.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>3
The scattered rioters appear strangely used to acting as an organization. They've somehow acquired Reunion uniforms and have begun acting as such. Their by-laws? Nothing but destruction.

lt_01_05.name: Sand Beast Cave
lt_01_05.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>4
A group of exiled mercenaries have taken to using the place as a ranch. The sand beasts feed on the mutated Originium slugs, and often race about the mine in excitement after a meal.

lt_01_06.name: Equipment Acceptance Testing
lt_01_06.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>5
The mine has just purchased a new batch of vehicles from another city, intending to modify them for mineral transport. The docking process was rather smooth, until people broke into the final acceptance testing site.

lt_01_07.name: Secret Base
lt_01_07.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>6
Defender Elites dig to expand the available space, while engineers take apart and reassemble the existing electrical equipment. These rioters disguised as Reunion have unscrupulously taken over the mine and are preparing to convert it into a secret base.

lt_01_08.name: Nature's Premature Death
lt_01_08.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>7
An eye opens in the darkness, slag falling from its eyelid like a inky black waterfall. It has always lived in the depths of this mine. Is it a creature nurtured by nature, or a victim of the steady progress of civilization?

lt_02_01.name: Good Neighbor
lt_02_01.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>0
During the mine's inactivity, the neighboring forest farm has 'legally' expanded its territory. You approach them to get in touch, but their patrol hounds and security personnel are not particularly welcoming.

lt_02_02.name: Groundbreaking Ceremony
lt_02_02.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>1
The groundbreaking ceremony's congratulatory salvo has barely faded when hordes of metal crabs and armed rioters surge in from all directions. They are almost certainly not here to celebrate.

lt_02_03.name: Wanderers' Shelter
lt_02_03.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>2
To these Sarkaz mercenaries who lost their home and wandered so far to get here, having their territory seized is a humiliation of the highest order. You are viewed as invaders trespassing on their domain.

lt_02_04.name: 'Arena'
lt_02_04.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>3
The local fanatics have dressed up like Kazimierz knights, shirking honest work and instead fighting each other in duels... They've set up an arena in the mine.

lt_02_05.name: Leaving Home
lt_02_05.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>4
After leaving their homes in search of better job opportunities, these Tiacauh Warriors and Shieldguards were hired to 'fight evil' at the mine. They've obviously been taken for a ride.

lt_02_06.name: Originium Pollution
lt_02_06.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>5
The mine once accidentally unearthed an Originium Slug nest, resulting in serious contamination of the site. Now, the cleanup has once again disturbed those same Infected creatures, as they rush to the surface in a bid to escape to the wilderness.

lt_02_07.name: Vicious Competition
lt_02_07.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>6
A large number of mercenaries and wandering Infected have rushed into the mine and are sowing chaos in an organized manner. Upon investigation, it appears they were hired by a competing miners in the same city.

lt_02_08.name: Unto the Breach
lt_02_08.description:
<@lv.fs>Starting Danger Level: </>7
A gigantic creature of unknown origin tears through the earth and rocks as gang members and thugs gather around it, rapidly approaching the recently cleaned up mining site together. Is it under the control of these villains, or is it spurring them on?

lt_03_01.name: Right of Way
lt_03_01.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>0
A group of armed engineers claim that the mining platform is in their way. They demand that it move aside, or allow them to pass through it.

lt_03_02.name: Coming Prepared
lt_03_02.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>1
Members in heavy equipment draw attention while their allies penetrate the defense line into the mining layer. These people came prepared.

lt_03_03.name: Organized Ranks
lt_03_03.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>2
There was a misunderstanding between the engineers and the Shieldguard. The warriors who broke away from Reunion have not lost their way: they remain organized and disciplined, defending Ursus in their own way.

lt_03_04.name: 'Ursus Tournament'
lt_03_04.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>3
The insurgents have obtained the gear of Kazimierz Knightclubs. The rules of the tournament have been simplified: lives equal points. The faint-of-heart are relegated to the spectator stands. The restoration of the mining platform seems to have interrupted their 'tournament.'

lt_03_05.name: 'Undisciplined Rabble'
lt_03_05.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>4
Bouncers, thugs, vagrants... vagabonds of all sorts come looking for trouble as the cleanup continues. Seems like this is about more than just protection money.

lt_03_06.name: Engineering Checkup
lt_03_06.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>5
As the mining platform links up with the nomadic city for maintenance, militants disguised as engineers sabotage the platform under the cover of drones.

lt_03_07.name: Sudden Visit
lt_03_07.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>6
A group claiming to be Ursus military tries to shut down the mining platform, saying that they received a tip-off regarding Reunion remnants in the area. They have not been able to present proper identification, however.

lt_03_08.name: Long Journey
lt_03_08.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>7
It climbs out slowly, wearing its massive 'hut' on its back and leaving a trail of glowing lights behind, illuminating the dark underground world. There was a plan in place to relocate it, but unexpected interference has complicated things.

lt_04_01.name: Serendipity
lt_04_01.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>0
Słoma Foods originally touted knight tournaments as one of the perks of working on its platforms, but few knights are willing to fight in such tiny arenas. Ironically, it is now inhabited by those who are down on their luck since the platform's abandonment.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_02.name: True or False
lt_04_02.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>1
There have been many sightings of Brassrust since his disappearance, but all have turned out to be imitators. This one should be no exception.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_03.name: Gentle Nights
lt_04_03.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>2
The neon lights of the city struggle to illuminate the deeply-rooted darkness. The light of a candle may be able to do so... or maybe not.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_04.name: Rock and a Hard Place
lt_04_04.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>3
Retired competition knights usually fade into obscurity, though there are always some fans who never forget―not necessarily to the benefit of the knights themselves.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_05.name: Battered Branches
lt_04_05.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>4
It is a massive labyrinth within the food processing platform. Even twins may lose sight of each other.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_06.name: Journey's Rest
lt_04_06.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>5
'Civilization' is everywhere in Kazimierz. The more you scorn it, the closer it creeps.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_07.name: Scattered Dirt
lt_04_07.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>6
Goods are chosen, goods are made, goods are thrown away. Neither the production line nor the goods need subjectivity.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

lt_04_08.name: Bottomless Pit
lt_04_08.description:
<@lv.fs>Initial Danger: </>7
Pincers used for fighting have degenerated, while its mouthparts have been twisted into tentacles. The mutations brought on by consuming too much industrial material have made this Gloompincer unrecognizable in both form and behavior, a mouth that is constantly trying to fill its insatiable stomach.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.

tile_bigforce.name: Specialist Tactical Point
tile_bigforce.description: Increases the push and pull strength of the Operator on it.

tile_corrosion.name: Corrosive Ground
tile_corrosion.description: Reduces DEF by half of the Operator on it.

tile_deepwater.name: Deep Water Zone
tile_deepwater.description: Represents the water terrain far from the shore

tile_defup.name: Defensive Rune
tile_defup.description: Increases DEF of the Operator on it.

tile_end.name: Protection Objective
tile_end.description: Blue objective point. Its HP decreases when an enemy unit enters it.

tile_fence.name: Fence
tile_fence.description: Can deploy melee unit on it. Impassable

tile_fence_bound.name: Fence
tile_fence_bound.description: Can deploy melee units on it. Enemies cannot enter

tile_floor.name: Non-deployable Area
tile_floor.description: Can't deploy melee unit on it. Passable

tile_flystart.name: Aerial Unit Incursion Point
tile_flystart.description: Enemy aerial units will enter the battlefield from here.

tile_forbidden.name: No Entry Zone
tile_forbidden.description: Can't deploy melee unit on it. Impassable

tile_gazebo.name: Anti-Air Rune
tile_gazebo.description: Slightly reduces ASPD but greatly increases ATK against aerial units of the Operator on it.

tile_grass.name: Bush

act11d0_lock01.lockDesc: Within this perilous occupied zone, the truth is hidden among outbursts of violence.

ssData.name: Darknights Memoir
ssData.desc:
This is the story of a mercenary, venturing through life and death on the battlefield.
This is the story of a follower, trusted by others yet failing to protect.
This is the story of a dissident, fighting endlessly, scorning life and death all the while.
This is the story of W, and her companions.

ssData.name: A Walk in the Dust
ssData.desc:
The extent of Kal'tsit's influence is immeasurable.
Ursus, Victoria, and Sargon all bear marks of her presence.
Whatever her role may be, she firmly and persistently pursues her own vision.
Those who journey alongside her, too, are busily authoring the stories of their own lives.
Time stops for no one, and Kal'tsit continues marching onward.

collectData.name: Vigilo
collectData.desc:
A person from the past,
a landship sailing through the present,
and a gaze rising from the future.

ssData.name: Babel
ssData.desc:
Babel, a land of dreams where the past calls to the future.
The tower that resolves differences points towards the truth.
The King of Sarkaz steals the flame of hope, and the sparks reignite war.
Kin turn their swords on each other, and heroes rise from the ruins.
An assassination puts an end to their differences, but fate is inextricably linked to the truth.
The visionary calls out the idealist's epitaph.
The King may be gone, but her dreams live on.

ssData.name: Ending a Grand Overture
ssData.desc:
Vina Victoria looks back from the stairs
and sees her Glasgow companions, along with the city's scars.
The war has already ended, but blood still flows.
The one missing from the funeral, the one who betrayed the crown,
the one who returned to the ruins of Norport...
Vina Victoria's heroics ended with the war,
but she remains Vina.

collectData.name: See You Soon
collectData.desc:
'War is dead'. Londinium's static gunsmoke thus declared.
Purple flames crawl up the city walls. Canoes leave the river.
A sword-wielder steps into the golden sea.
No one can truly kill death and war,
but at least for now, some still yearn for peace.

ssData.name: Guide Ahead
ssData.desc:
A grand and unprecedented Summit of Nations,
Gathering envoys from all lands to the holy city of Laterano.
Beneath an eternal halo, they share joy and glory;
Amidst ceaseless gunshots, they fend off pain and darkness.
Foreign travelers marvel at the scenery, while returning Messengers silently pray:
May supreme grace be bestowed upon us, may eternal redemption descend to us.
May you and I, guided by the light, journey ahead to an unknown horizon.

ssData.name: Hortus de Escapismo
ssData.desc:
After sixty years of silence, Sanctilaminium Ambrosii sends out a cry for help.
Paradise is stranded in the barrens, and order teeters on the brink of destruction.
It can take years to establish a true friendship, yet the collapse of trust can happen in seconds.
The pious have no choice but to renounce their faith, and the innocent must take on sin and plea mercy.
The young saint asks himself: how do you correct suffering if it was not caused by error?

ssData.name: The Masses' Travels
ssData.desc:
The Second Summit of Nations begins.
The land's enemies, the sea's strangers,
all have gathered at Laterano.
The centuries-old order of the Holy City,
shall be the salvation of all, living or not.
At what price cometh salvation?
Only the Laterans can know.

ssData.name: Break the Ice
ssData.desc:
The mountains guard ancient beliefs 
and the snow hides great dangers 
in this realm of snow.
The gods have watched over these 
rarely-visited cliffs for a thousand years.
Smoke rises gently from chimneys in this peaceful land,
its tranquility broken by a great train rushing through.

ssData.name: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze
ssData.desc:
A girl from Ursus walks off the train with her mother's keepsake.
A Victorian veteran gazes upon his men with a solemn expression.
An exiled Kazimierzian champion wipes the blood off her hands.
The new masters of Kjerag maneuver for advantage, but its guardian's brow is furrowed.
The one in the shadows tugs on the brim of his hat, certain there is something going on.
The train to Lake Silberneherze is about to depart.
Take your seats, ladies and gentlemen.

ssData.name: Il Siracusano
ssData.desc:
The invitation is unexpected, but she knew it would come some day.
The explosion is premeditated, but he was well aware it would happen eventually.
The gunshot resounds through the clouds, and he has waited several decades for it.
The farewell is long overdue, and she turns away with no intention to stay.
The city is in its rainy season, so don't forget to bring an umbrella.

ssData.name: I Portatori dei Velluti
ssData.desc:
Nuova Volsinii, where turbulent undercurrents churn beneath a superficial peace.
A car accident smashes the fragile tranquility into bits.
Famiglie and violence have worn innumerable masks, but the banner of order will not tolerate a single stain.
Judge, killer, Fang, tailor, Infected...
A cab drives through the city like a specter
as Lappland meticulously weaves a surprise for a grand performance.
A plot or a gamble? Just hurry over to the Carnevale, and revel in the fun together!

ssData.name: Maria Nearl
ssData.desc:
Consumption and entertainment suffuse the modern land of the knights.
For the sake of her family's prestige,
a young Maria Nearl embarks on the path to the Kazimierz Major.
However, the young lady has yet to realize the meaning the word 'knight' now carries,
nor is she aware of the inner workings of modern Kazimierz......
A long and arduous journey lies ahead of Maria.

collectData.name: Pinus Sylvestris
collectData.desc:
A power struggle, a family dispute,
and everyone finds it difficult to return to their old selves.
For Sona, every decision made is both a burden
and a hope for the Infected by her side.
She must be like the needle leaf of a Pinus Sylvestris, sharp and resolute.

ssData.name: Near Light
ssData.desc:
The return of the Radiant Knight 
pushes the Special Knight Tournament to a climax. 
At the same time, in the dark corners where the neon lights do not shine, 
the suppressed roars are about to break their shackles. 
On the stage, the paths of the knights cross. 
Below the stage, the city lingers on the brink. 
Soon, the two paths will converge...

collectData.name: An Obscure Wanderer
collectData.desc:
Perhaps the things of old that seem overly wonderful
can no longer exist,
much like the last rays of a sunset.
With the dusk crossing his back, Młynar searches for a way out.

collectData.name: Ancient Forge
collectData.desc:
According to ancient legend, a giant monster might attack us at any moment!
How will the lonely city of Lungmen manage to survive an astonishing explosion and make it to the new year?
The red-hot blockbuster 'Lungmen Doomwatch'... No, we'll call it 'Ancient Forge'!
Anyway, look forward to it!

ssData.name: Who Is Real
ssData.desc:
Lava and Kroos, who arrived in Yan at the behest of Nian, 
meet a resident of Yan who encountered some trouble in the wilderness, Mr. Nothing. 
Together, the three of them follow the clues and search for Mount Hui-ch'i, to look for Nian's sister. 
An unassuming thatched house reveals a hidden world the moment they enter. 
Regaining their wits, they find themselves in a quaint little Yan town. 
Beneath the coexisting sun and moon, the town besieged by spirits of ink. A mysterious monk whose words bring truth:
True or false, false or true, you and I are but inhabitants of a painting.

ssData.name: Invitation to Wine
ssData.desc:
The dreamer becomes drunk at the ancient pavilion.
The spring gusts blow through the mountains, and the shadow reveals its true face through the clouds.
Old matters yet to be resolved, a new game of chess has begun in Shangshu.
A visitor from distant Lungmen,
an antique goblet hidden in a box,
a piece that has long been in the game,
a lonely little boat, rowed into Shancheng.

ssData.name: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow
ssData.desc:
Climb a hundred-year city, and bid farewell to its hundred-year guardian.
The court is as high as jianghu is far. A plot ferments beneath the dust clouds.
The wind and sand cannot break the poplar. The walls formed by will do not fear Catastrophe.
Speak of the sword, reminisce about old times, while the wine is warm.
On the chessboard, love and hatred, all to dust.
Beat the drums, and see old friends off.

collectData.name: A Death in Chunfen
collectData.desc:
A stubborn stone falls off a cliff. Will it wither and rot, or smash into pieces?
A drop of rain long craved by a mountain village turns into a surging deluge,
taking lives, names, and the very meaning of 'benevolence' from Moushan's name.
The blade in Qiubai's hand can protect lives, but cannot rein in the will of the people.
Mountains surround Moushan village, but outside the mountain range,
just how many more incidents like this are transpiring?

ssData.name: Here A People Sows
ssData.desc:
She touches the rice grains with her finger, closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath. It is a scent that has not changed for a thousand years.
She opens her eyes again, and those who sweat with her in the fields seem almost the same as the ones a thousand years ago.
Her spirit has become engrained within this soil over the centuries.
She continues to protect this field of gold, even as the land becomes ill and evil grows.
A thread flies into the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities, in search of her freedom.
Vernal winds turn to rain, nourishing flora and fauna. She returns a stranger, and free.
It is still peace and a good harvest that she seeks.

ssData.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion
ssData.desc:
A rain of parting drenches the shoulders and sleeves of many around the Forbidden City.
A letter to Victoria, enclosed with unspeakable melancholy.
A sudden fire burns down half a lifetime's work, difficult to clean.
A soup stewing for a century—will it manage to grant him a chance on the front line?
Perhaps that so-called history was never a conspiracy,
just unavoidable actions taken in unavoidable situations...
A situation difficult to deal with since antiquity. If we have a reunion, we should enjoy ourselves to the fullest.

collectData.name: Fantasy in the Mirage
collectData.desc:
At the foot of Mt. Mang, there is a forgotten town where everything feels wrong.
Books are read aloud in vacant rooms. Tea boils, fragrant, and the pot pours on its own.
This splendid land, this deep-seated love. One laments this life, yet cannot bear to leave its taste behind. All one could wish is to stay.

ssData.name: Mansfield Break
ssData.desc:
Years ago, Anthony Simon was incarcerated in Mansfield State Prison. 
All the while, he has been plotting to escape and uncover the truth. 
Little did he know, a plot targeting him was unfolding at the same time. 
Silence who coincidentally discovered Anthony's existence, Saria who had already taken action, 
Muelsyse whose intentions remain uncertain, as well as HydeBro and the Director of Energy behind them. 
Perhaps a late-night talk in the bar will shed some light on the truth behind this conspiracy, 
and lift a corner off the veil of secrecy covering Rhine Lab.

ssData.name: Dorothy's Vision
ssData.desc:
Weaved from science, computed from dreams.
Data and experiments have created a behemoth.
It floats above Trimounts, gazing silently at all that happens below.
Forward or backwards, the direction of science holds true.
It is always progressing, for good or for ill.

ssData.name: Lone Trail
ssData.desc:
Kristen's disappearance stirs everyone's emotions.
The military and the Maylander Foundation gather in Trimounts.
Kal'tsit chooses to intervene.
Dark clouds gather as a rainstorm draws near.
Is this a conspiracy, a farce, or one's lone awakening?
Old grudges now cross paths here, as the past and the present clash.
Tonight, nobody sleeps.

ssData.name: Grani and the Knights' Treasure
ssData.desc:
Dewville, a remote village in Kazimierz has been occupied by bounty hunters.
These bounty hunters indiscriminately rampage and ruin, apparently in an attempt to find the knight's treasure said to be buried here.
After receiving a request for help, Mounted Police Grani volunteers to resolve the problem.
Can she really drive out the bounty hunters?
Will she find the mysterious knight's treasure?
Will peace return to Dewville?
Let's find it out.

ssData.name: Under Tides
ssData.desc:
Skadi hears the trill of a long unheard melody at Rhodes Island.
Following the sound, she meets Gladiia.
Yet, this former comrade swiftly disappears after little more than a glimpse.
She kidnapped Specter, leaving nothing but a name for Skadi.
'Sal Viento', a lethargic and mysterious coastal town.
There, Skadi will unravel the mystery of her and her companions' bloodline.

ssData.name: Stultifera Navis
ssData.desc:
A nation sunken in silence has left its legacy upon the waves.
The Hunters follow their kin's trail to where the clues converge.
Stultifera Navis, the golden ship, a monument to civilization.
Kal'tsit warns that humanity must unite.
Iberia no longer knows the sea, and Ægir has taken in foreign blood.
The sea alone is the source of all life, and the sea alone is unchanging.

ssData.name: Path of Life
ssData.desc:
The city of Milliarium breaks through a siege,
a representative of Ægir's first attempt to communicate with the land.
A swarm of We Many comes out in force, moving towards ripples surfacing on both land and sky.
A lost forefather returns home, a lone Abyssal Hunter sinks into the abyss once more,
and an extinguished beacon lights up again...
An unprecedented ultra Waterway forms in-between the waves, connecting land to sea—
between Ægir and Seaborn, who will rush towards their last chance for life?

ssData.name: Exodus from the Pale Sea
ssData.desc:
Thorns goes into the Iberian Salt Flats in search of lost swordsmanship,
but is kidnapped by desert bandits and must refine a compass in exchange for his freedom.
The alchemists once tamed the sea with this compass,
and even today the sound of waves can still be heard within the white salt dunes.
As sails raise on a dilapidated ship,
is there anything else you still long for outside the Pale Sea?

ssData.name: Twilight of Wolumonde
ssData.desc:
Folinic and Suzuran arrive at this place, searching for the missing Atro.
Wolumonde, 'The Eighth Moon' of the Leithanien's Winterwisp Mountains.
Under the threat of Catastrophes, the town remains still while suspicion lurks in the people's eyes.
A great fire extinguishes many lives, but from the ashes more questions rise.
With the arrival of Reunion, the conflict between the Infected and the townsfolk reaches a climax.
Will this incident be resolved? Will there be answers to the mystery?
Please investigate the truth hidden in the twilight, alongside the operators of Rhodes Island.

ssData.name: Lingering Echoes
ssData.desc:
Leithanien, land of spires, home to wisdom and music.
The shadows of days past are gone, and the light of dawn fills the streets.
Afterglow Hall, Vyseheim.
Strings stretched to the breaking point are about to play their last notes.
Keys of black and white are trapped by the stave lines of destiny.
A forgotten melody begins to grow in obsession.
The sounds of joy drift in the glow, as no one notices that the sun has begun to set.

ssData.name: Zwillingstürme im Herbst
ssData.desc:
Twenty-three years ago, the Golden Moon witnessed the collapse of that towering spire.
Has Leithanien embraced a new chapter as it wished?
Have the tyrant's ambitions and sins been buried along with all the pain and doubt he brought?
When the poet returns to her homeland where the marigolds bloom, and the traveler plucks the strings of her cello,
do the people beneath the Twin Spires still harbor hopes and dreams? Do they still wander freely?
May all doubts be finally dispelled, may all questions be answered.
'I am this eternal nation. I am my own eternal king.'

ssData.name: What the Firelight Casts
ssData.desc:
Tara, a vaguely-defined region, a muddy morass... 
A homeland that can be found only in old songs.
She once escaped from there, only to bury everything about herself and return again.
'Lost souls' emerge from the shadows, and Dublinn's march leaves scorch marks across the land.
The red dragon, endowed by her bloodline with the flame of life, must bear the weight of life itself.
What, then, does the firelight cast? Whose shadow am I now?

ssData.name: When Elegies Are Ashes
ssData.desc:
Na Saoirsí: a devastated city, an exhausted heart...
A secret guarded by woods and fog.
Loughshinny comes with a vision of peace, holding true to her promise.
Meanwhile, that manipulator of death has prepared a long enough story to tell.
As Red Dragon slays Red Dragon, blessings return to their gifter, and the departed return to fire.
Then what? What sort of future will the flames bring to Tara now?

ssData.name: Heart of Surging Flame
ssData.desc:
The Obsidian Festival is in full swing in the town of Siesta!
The Operators of Rhodes Island have come for a vacation as well.
Not before long, they learned that the eruption of a nearby volcano is imminent!
But it seems the town's government is trying to cover it up?!
In the midst of the summer heat, music and battle, 
Rhodes Island will set out with the mayor's daughter, Ceylon.
Will they manage to save the day?

ssData.name: The Great Chief Returns
ssData.desc:
The doctor, Gavial, and co. travel to Gavial's hometown on a low-altitude aircraft.
Acahualla, a place of lush forests within Sargon.
Close to their destination, the aircraft is struck down!
The doctor and Gavial have no choice but to travel on foot to the settlements to seek help.
What plots and threats do the vast rainforests hide?
Will the Rhodes Island operators be able to repair their aircraft and return?
Gavial, this is your home turf. It's all on you now!

ssData.name: Dossoles Holiday
ssData.desc:
Ch'en was invited to spend the summer at Dossoles, Bolívar.
Little did she know that she would run into Lin Yühsia there.
Meanwhile, the most unique city in Bolívar is about to hold its most significant annual event: the 
Dossoles Warrior Championship.
Where there is light, however, there is always shadow,
and this shadow threatens to consume the entire city.
What is the danger that Ch'en and Lin Yühsia are sensing?

ssData.name: Ideal City: Endless Carnival
ssData.desc:
Gavial and Eunectes head home in response to a call for help.
Elysium and the Acahualla go underground to solve a problem.
When they arrive at the underground city, they find a situation they never imagined.
The Durin enjoy a cool summer splash beneath a broken dome.
Competition, conflict, crisis; all must take a back seat.
Cool off and drink to your heart's content. After the party is another party!

ssData.name: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home
ssData.desc:
Siesta is moved onto a nomadic city, and leaves the shadow of the volcano.
Their new homes may be built, but the people do not wish to give up their memories.
A volcanologist reaches out to touch the past, when clouds suddenly float down as balls of fluff.
The night breeze melts away the dreams of summer, while guitars strum out gentle notes.
The pulse of the land blazes white hot, and the volcano known as 'Love' will erupt someday...
It is parting, and reunion, and the song ever-present in the heart.

ssData.name: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun
ssData.desc:
In Sargon, Menat-Ha'mait's Flood Festival approaches,
and the museum antiques have come to life?!
To become a real historian,
Padishah's daughter, Pepe, decides to gather gemstones and unlock the secrets of the Shah's treasury!
The river always flows, and the sun rises and sets eternal.
Those willing to slumber find their own feelings once more, and choose a farewell to eternity.
And those who shake off the sun will never stop in their tracks again.

ssData.name: Ato
ssData.desc:
Kajimachi's night stretches long.
Lights still burn, the game goes on, even wind steers clear of the streets.
There are names you only whisper. There are rules you don't dare break.
A letter brought back someone who should've stayed away.
Uninvited, they were already at the table, long before the game began.
When noise was gone, only cooled ashes remained in the city.
Nita Street. The last television went dark before the hanabi faded.

ssData.name: Code of Brawl
ssData.desc:
Bison of MountainDash Logistics was ambushed and is hanging on for dear life?
His saviors are not his father's men, but Penguin Logistics?
It's Sauin, yet the darker undercurrents of Lungmen are out in force?
Who is the actual underground mastermind of Lungmen?
MountainDash Logistics? Penguin Logistics? The Siracusan Mafia? Or someone else?
In the dark of the night, an unmissable feast is about to begin!

ssData.name: Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures
ssData.desc:
The residual heat from the energy tower once warmed Davistown.
Yet, the future they once hoped for has drifted away like white smoke from a chimney.
Intractable problems, things that can no longer be protected...
The bitterly cold winds blow, promising a long and relentless winter.
Jessica stands in the snow, gun aimed skyward—
For an elusive promise, for a helpless sigh.
For the ruins of dreams and homes.

ssData.name: Act or Die
ssData.desc:
A film crew trapped on a Wrankwood studio plate in the barrens.
A death from years ago rears its head again.
Joy, confusion, fear, anger, and hatred take the stage in turn...
Until blood paints the final scene of the drama.
Who wrote this absurd tragedy, with emotion as their pen?
Lucian lifts the curtains to take the stage as the star.

collectData.name: Operational Intelligence
collectData.desc:
A whisper in the smoke, a choice made under a knife... 
War has never respected borders,
and the battlefield is never lacking in buried stories.

collectData.name: Stories of Afternoon
collectData.desc:
Rhodes Island's Operators hail from all over the land, their personalities sometimes similar and sometimes clashing.
They cooperate smoothly on the battlefield,
and in their camaraderie also make unforgettable memories off of it.

collectData.name: Children of Ursus
collectData.desc:
It was such a long winter in Chernobog.
The lingering chill still haunts the survivors of Peterheim Middle School.
The things they cannot change, face, or retrieve.
The reasons they must remember, push on, and believe.

collectData.name: Rewinding Breeze
collectData.desc:
The lands within our memories, both clear and vague.
The footprints that stretch from past to present. And the people.
On Rhodes Island's deck, we survey, cherish, and pursue.

collectData.name: Beyond Here
collectData.desc:
Every journey is a test of faith,
and a search for one's self. Outside the Rhodes Island landship,
Operators set out on their own journeys, and witness different sights.

collectData.name: Preluding Lights
collectData.desc:
This great land has never shown its kindness easily.
The people face hardship, and with their own choices hammer down the rivets of fate.
For even on the most desolate soil, there exists a spark of hope.

collectData.name: A Light Spark in Darkness
collectData.desc:
Under Caladon's dark clouds, a great fire burns the Green Spark to the ground
and destroys Susie's tiny yet unreachable dream.
Behind the dense smoke, an ugly conspiracy against the Infected begins to spread...

collectData.name: To Be Continued
collectData.desc:
From the Snow Realms to Siesta, Siracusa to Kazimierz,
seawater splashes from one end and soon turns to snowflakes on the other.
People are the same. Migration, contact, solitude, reunion.
Even after the camera lens moves away, life goes on.

collectData.name: The Black Forest Wills A Dream
collectData.desc:
An expedition team lost in the depths of the icefield sends a distress signal to the outside world.
Ursus is not the only infiltrator in Sami's forest.
Tribes that have gone their separate ways, and outsiders traveling together—
will you choose to go north, or south?

collectData.name: To the Grinning Valley
collectData.desc:
The Doctor and Amiya return to Rim Billiton, and together with Savage
they brush past their past journey, but unexpectedly run into a truck crashing a gate.
Can the Feranmut chaser find the light she was looking for...?

collectData.name: A Kazdelian Rescue
collectData.desc:
Flames burst from the Soul Furnace,
bringing brief but dazzling fireworks to Kazdel,
as well as... a nice dream of the future.
